notes.title: How to prepare for the Return to Beast's Castle update in Disney Dreamlight Valley
notes.content: Disney Dreamlight Valley is rolling out its next update, Return to Beast's Castle, on October 1, 2025, which will take us back to the Beauty and the Beast realm to meet two new characters. We've only had a very brief look into the update, revealing that Cogsworth and Lumiere will be joining us, but outside of that, the adventure largely remains a mystery... Read more.

notes.title: Disney Dreamlight Valley's newest free update is coming next week, and will take us back to one of my favourite realms
notes.content: Disney Dreamlight Valley has announced that its next free update, Return to Beast's Castle, will be dropping on October 1. As the title suggests, it will whisk us back to the Beauty and the Beast realm, and plans to add a few fan favourite characters for us to invite to the valley... Read more.

notes.title: Discover the Emotional Rescue Update!
notes.content: [p]Hey Valley Villagers![/p][p]Are you ready to get in touch with your emotions? [i]Disney Dreamlight Valley’[/i]s latest free update, Emotional Rescue, arrives today on all platforms![/p][p]Step into the shoes of a Mind Worker, embark on an inspirational journey with a couple of memorable new Villagers, set off on a Star Path oozing with Nostalgia, and dig into groovy new upgrades![/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="9Dd9-CFhrrg;full"][/previewyoutube][h2]Motivate inspiration[/h2][p]With a new door appearing in the Dream Castle, you’ll need to repair a special memory orb to open it and cross over into...[/p][p]The Headquarters from Disney Pixar’s [i]Inside Out[/i]! Riley has an upcoming school talent show and it’s up to you to help Joy and Sadness inspire her! Work together to find memories and create dreams that will encourage Riley to put on a great performance.[/p][p]First, you’ll meet Joy, who will need a hand with the emotional control console, and then Sadness, who has taken a literal walk down memory lane.[/p][h2]Lights, camera, emote![/h2][p]Once you have the emotional rescuers together, you’ll need to brainstorm and put motivational dreams into production on the Dream Productions backlot![/p][p]Once you’ve successfully ignited Riley’s imagination, you’ll be able to set up Joy and Sadness’ remote HQ and welcome them into your Valley![/p][h2]Turn that Valley frown upside down[/h2][p]With the feelings now out and about in the Valley, it’s not all sunshine and rainbows. Help Joy solve the Valley’s mood swings and explore the possibility of an ‘Imagination Land’. Then, help Sadness fix a ‘rainy day’ and connect with your sensitive side. Together, explore hidden “crying clouds” and follow a soft, tearful trail that leads to something unexpectedly healing.[/p][h2]A cozy place to be[/h2][p]But that’s not all – the Valley’s busy energy can be overwhelming for Sadness. She needs a quiet, special place to just be.[/p][p]Help build this peaceful sanctuary, which may stir old memories and doubts, but with care and kindness, you’ll share a touching moment reminding us all that it’s okay to feel down sometimes.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42317391/0ad37a5d50ff8109a31ee6a25fd817559555760b.png"][/img][/p][h2]Retro Roadtrip Star Path[/h2][p]Craving more nostalgia? Why not take a heartfelt trip back in time with retro furniture, vintage summer fashions, and all the classic [i]feels [/i]to warm your heart.[/p][p]Plus, enjoy a cozy drive-in movie night, dance to jukebox tunes and unwind at the iconic Cozy Cone Motel with bonus rewards to sweeten your trip.[/p][h2]Companions[/h2][p]Need more companions? Now you’ll be able to have two companions around at the same time!  Not to mention, you’ll also be able to assign certain companions to select Villagers! See our [url="https://disneydreamlightvalley.com/news/update-aug-20-2025"]Patch Notes[/url] for details![/p][p]Speaking of companions, get ready to collect new adorable friends, like the playful Rock and Roll Fox that will add a splash of fun to your Valley adventures.[/p][p]And there’s a little extra magic too, with Lucky, the charming pup from Disney’s[i] 101 Dalmatians[/i] joining the Premium Shop.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42317391/0a3c5f07b946df84f002e935396685ee0488ae19.png"][/img][/p][h2]Valley Events[/h2][p]Starting September 3rd, the Memory Mania Mini-Event returns to the Valley, giving you the chance to earn new rewards through September 16th![/p][p]Jump into Emotional Rescue now and experience all the magic, nostalgia and heartfelt moments waiting for you in the Valley! Don’t forget to connect with us on our official social media to share your in-game adventures with us by tagging us in your content![/p][p][/p][p][b]Instagram[/b]: [url="https://gmlft.co/DDV-Instagram"]https://gmlft.co/DDV-Instagram[/url][/p][p][b]X[/b]: [url="https://gmlft.co/DDV-X"]https://gmlft.co/DDV-X[/url][/p][p][b]Facebook[/b]: [url="https://gmlft.co/DDV-Facebook"]https://gmlft.co/DDV-Facebook[/url][/p][p][b]YouTube[/b]: [url="https://gmlft.co/DDV-YouTube"]https://gmlft.co/DDV-YouTube[/url][/p][p][b]TikTok[/b]: [url="https://gmlft.co/DDV-TikTok"]https://gmlft.co/DDV-TikTok[/url][/p][p][/p][p]As always, should you run into any issues while playing [i]Disney Dreamlight Valley[/i], we first recommend that you check out our known issues [url="https://trello.com/b/WY5gDde3/disney-dreamlight-valley-issue-tracker-board"]here[/url]. If you don’t see the issue you’re running into, you can get in touch with our Support team via [url="https://gameloft.helpshift.com/hc/en/66-disney-dreamlight-valley/"]our contact form[/url]. Stumped with a certain quest or objective? Check out our friendly [url="https://discord.com/invite/disneydreamlightvalley"]Discord Community[/url] for some [i]Disney Dreamlight Valley [/i]tips and tricks![/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Disney Dreamlight Valley is making some significant changes to Star Paths ahead of its next update to make it more engaging for 'those who play week over week'
notes.content: head of the new Emotional Rescue update, Disney Dreamlight Valley has announced that some significant changes are being made to its current Star Path format. As detailed on the Disney Dreamlight Valley blog, these changes are being made to help make the Star Path feel more accessible for every player, regardless of where they are in the valley and how much progress they have made within the game... Read more.

notes.title: How to prepare for the Emotional Rescue update in Disney Dreamlight Valley
notes.content: Disney Dreamlight Valley is rolling out its Emotional Rescue update on Wednesday, August 20, bringing two new characters to the valley for us to invite. But you can't just enjoy all the new toys right away; there will be a number of challenges to work on and hoops to jump through to get Joy and Sadness to our valley, alongside a new realm to unlock, which means a lot of work to someone who's not quite ready to jump straight in... Read more.

notes.title: Emotional Rescue Update Patch Notes
notes.content: [p]Hey Valley Villagers![/p][p]We’re thrilled to have given you a first look at the [b]Emotional Rescue [/b]free update in our latest [url="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ifx8vineBcI"]Developer Update[/url] video! Through these patch notes, we'll be giving you an even closer look at the inspirational journey you'll embark on.[/p][p]Get ready to get in touch with your feelings in Emotional Rescue with Joy and Sadness, from Disney Pixar’s [i]Inside Out[/i]! Explore the Headquarters and step into the shoes of a Mind Worker to locate the missing parts of long-term memories![/p][p]Disney Dreamlight Valley’s Emotional Rescue update arrives on August 20th, 2025, so check out the details below:[/p][h2]NEW CONTENT[/h2][list][*][p]Head over to the Dream Castle, find a new door, and cross over into a memorable realm.[/p][/*][*][p]Meet Joy and Sadness in the Headquarters and put together a grand Dream Production to help inspire Riley for an upcoming talent show![/p][/*][*][p]Place a remote Headquarters in your Valley to welcome Joy and then Sadness, along with their memorable Quests.[/p][/*][*][p]Assist Joy in solving the Valley’s mood swings and help Sadness fix a ‘rainy day’ to collect heartwarming Friendship rewards.[/p][/*][*][p]Buckle up, we’re going on a road trip! A Retro Roadtrip Star Path to be precise! Embrace the breezy summer nostalgia, go fishing around the Valley, spend time with beloved pet companions, and snap photos with your Royal Phone! Capture all your Valley’s fun in the sun by collecting fabulous retro fashions, including a new Dream Style for Donald, a cool Rock and Roll Fox companion, and more![/p][/*][*][p]Starting on September 3rd , get ready to tap into the power of Nostalgia with the return of the Memory Mania Mini-Event! This time, you’ll need to locate Riley’s phone as it spawns around the Valley! Participate to earn new rewards, including the Nostalgia Capybara, until September 16th![/p][/*][*][p]Show us how you really feel, with the weekly DreamSnaps challenges arriving in Emotional ReScue![/p][/*][*][p]Speaking of emotions, prepare for a great many of them when Lucky, from Disney’s [i]101 Dalmatians[/i], joins the Valley through the Premium Shop![/p][/*][*][p]More optional items are coming to the Premium Shop for a limited time, including Dream Styles for Anna from Disney’s [i]Frozen[/i], and Tiana, from Disney’s [i]The Princess and the Frog[/i]![/p][/*][*][p]Be sure to keep an eye on the Scrooge McDuck’s Store each day for the chance to find new items.[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted available seasonal Moonstone packs that will be offered for a limited time. Different seasonal cosmetic items may be offered with future updates.[/p][/*][/list][p][i]Please note: Disney Dreamlight Valley Arcade Edition does not include seasonal Star Paths or the Premium Shop.[/i][/p][h2]STAR PATH[/h2][p]Discover a refreshed Star Path experience with new weekly Routine Duties, creative task types, and more rewarding progression designed to give you something fresh to do every week! [/p][p][b]Update to Duties from the current system[/b][/p][list][*][p]Character-specific duties have temporarily been removed (except Joy and Sadness).[/p][/*][*][p]You will no longer be required to complete Duties for previously released characters you have not yet unlocked.[/p][/*][*][p]The initial selection of Duties on day one of the event provides enough Tokens to unlock all rewards of the Star Path on the regular track. ((Non-Premium Star Path players must complete the currently active Routine Duties to earn Bonus Rewards, unlocking the next set as they go. Premium Star Path players can complete all released Routine Duties in any order to access Bonus Rewards.)[/p][/*][*][p]All additional Duties will go towards unlocking Star Path Bonus rewards.[/p][/*][*][p]Memory Orbs related Duties have been significantly reduced.[/p][/*][*][p]Restaurant-related duties have temporarily been removed.[/p][/*][*][p]Duties that require players to craft Training Manuals have been removed.[/p][/*][*][p]Previous Duties that were limited to a specific number of times per day and required multiple days to complete, have been removed.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]New Routine Duties[/b][/p][list][*][p]New Routine Duties unlocked each Wednesday for 5 consecutive weeks (pending on the length of the Star Path, this may vary in the future).[/p][/*][*][p]New Duty Types may appear in both Regular Duties and Routine Duties – In Emotional Rescue, there will be Photo Gallery [i](see details below)[/i] and Companion interaction related Duties.[/p][/*][*][p]Routine Duties earn you Tokens that can be spent on Star Path and Bonus Rewards. Completing all Routine Duties ensures you unlock every reward in both tracks.[/p][/*][*][p]Completing all weekly Routine Duties unlocks the following week’s Routine Duties.[/p][/*][*][p]If one jumps into the Star Path at a later date, they will need to complete the Routine Duties in the order they were released but will be able to catch up to that given week’s [b]live[/b][i] [/i]Routine Duties.[/p][/*][*][p]Premium Star Path allows for progress on all Routine Duties that have been released (linear path no longer required).[/p][/*][*][p]If one jumps into the Premium Star Path at a later date, they will be able to complete all the released Routine Duties, in whatever order they choose, in order to catch up to that given week’s [b]live[/b] Routine Duties.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Star Path end time and grace period[/b][/p][list][*][p]The active Duty period has been increased by 5 days for all players![/p][/*][*][p]The Grace period, where you can only trade and purchase additional Star Path Tokens, has been reduced and now lasts 48 hours.[/p][/*][/list][p]For a deeper dive into these changes, please visit our [url="https://disneydreamlightvalley.com/news/starpath-deep-dive"]Deep Dive on Star Path Changes[/url][b] [/b]blog article![/p][h2]IMPROVEMENTS[/h2][h3]DECORATING[/h3][p][b]Fence Improvements:[/b] Last update we enhanced your creative freedom by allowing for the ability to place diagonal Paths, and now we’re updating Fences! Seamlessly switch from “Line” to “Diagonal” fence modes for even more flexible designs and unique builds![/p][p][b]More Floating Islands:[/b] Owners of [i]Disney Dreamlight Valley: A Rift in Time[/i] will also have additional Floating Islands, each themed after their Biome counterpart and purchasable with Mist. [/p][p][b]Player House Improvements[/b]: Flex your interior decorator muscles with new customizable ceilings! Similar to how floors are decorated, choose from a series of assets to give your Player House a more unique look.[/p][p][b]Placing Large Items[/b]: It is now easier to target specific locations when placing large items in Edit Mode.[/p][h3]OTHER[/h3][list][*][p][b]More Companions:[/b] Players will now be able to equip TWO companions with them! All companion bonuses like extra inventory space and additional resource drops stack, and both companions gain experience simultaneously, helping level up your roster faster. .[/p][/*][*][p][b]Assign Companions:[/b] Players will now also be able to assign certain animal companions to Villagers![/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Pua to Moana or Maui[/p][/*][*][p]Heihei to Moana or Maui[/p][/*][*][p]Figaro to Minnie[/p][/*][*][p]The Footstool to The Beast or Belle[/p][/*][*][p]Dinah to Alice[/p][/*][*][p]Magic Carpet to Aladdin, Jasmine[/p][/*][*][p]Max to Prince Eric[/p][/*][*][p]Maleficent’s Raven to Maleficent[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]Uncrafting Station Revamp:[/b] You will now use Star Coins instead of Dreamlight to [i]uncraft [/i]items![/p][/*][*][p]For those who have used their Uncrafting Station prior to this update, keep an eye out for your inbox for a little something from the Cheshire Cat.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Stalls Accessibility[/b]: Certain stalls will become placeable in new Biomes across our expansion passes: Aladdin’s Gem Stall, The Beast’s Greenhouse, Kristoff’s Stall, Mulan’s Tea Stall, Tiana’s Meal Stall, Moana’s Fishing Boat, and WALL·E’s Garden.[/p][/*][*][p]Once placed, these stalls will not be removeable.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Photo Gallery[/b]: Save pictures to the brand-new Photo Gallery in your menu! Now you'll be able to take multiple photos for your DreamSnaps challenges, review, and submit directly from the Gallery![/p][/*][*][p]This feature will require an online connection to be enabled and can be viewed from any platform linked to your game profile.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Motifs for DreamSnaps[/b]: You can now add up to 5 Photomode motifs to your DreamSnaps![/p][/*][*][p][b]Tutorial for DreamSnaps:[/b] Updated tutorial for DreamSnaps, with new and more detailed quests with Vanellope.[/p][/*][*][p]Reworked quests: “The Haunting of Dreamlight Valley” and “Faith, Trust, and Pixel Dust”.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Shop UI:[/b] We’ve updated the look of the Premium Shop to be more dynamic and interactive, like adding previews for the item's grid size![/p][/*][*][p][b]Premium Shop Catalogue[/b]: Now you can check out new arrivals to the Premium Shop from your Mailbox![/p][/*][*][p][b]Expansion Update:[/b] For Storybook Vale Expansion Owners, the Teal Baby Dragon and Black Pegasus will both be available to collect in our next update, after Emotional Rescue.[/p][/*][/list][h2]TOP CHANGES AND BUG FIXES[/h2][list][*][p]The Teal Baby Dragon and Black Pegasus will both be notes.title: Disney Dreamlight Valley's newest update includes an Inside Out-themed realm, 2 characters, and a retro Star Path
notes.content: new developer update uploaded to YouTube has detailed Disney Dreamlight Valley's upcoming update, Emotional Rescue, which is set to arrive on August 20 with a new realm, two characters to invite to your valley, a fresh Star Path, and a number of new features to make valley life a little bit more streamlined. It's worth starting to save up your Dreamlight now, as these new valleys don't exactly come cheap... Read more.

notes.title: New Disney Dreamlight Valley DLC update welcomes Princess Aurora and Maleficent
notes.content:
It's been nearly three years since Disney Dreamlight Valley first came out, and it's yet to release its magical hold over me. Forget Stardew Valley, Palia, or Animal Crossing, I'd rather spend my evenings fishing with Goofy, cooking with Tiana, or delving into the Dreamlight library with Merlin. Now, with the long-awaited Sleeping Beauty arriving today, I can see my summer plans rapidly disappearing.

Read the rest of the story...

notes.title: The Storybook Vale - Part 2: The Unwritten Realm Update Patch Notes
notes.content: [p]Hey Valley Villagers![/p][p]This week, we conclude the final chapter of our paid expansion pass, Disney Dreamlight Valley: The Storybook Vale, with Part 2: The Unwritten Realm! Return to The Vale to rescue some old pals and befriend a couple of characters from Disney’s [i]Sleeping Beauty[/i]. Swipe your Royal Net at new evasive Snippets, solve new challenging puzzles and discover the forces behind all of this unrest![/p][p]This update will also include base game bug fixes for everyone![/p][p]The Storybook Vale – Part 2: The Unwritten Realm arrives on July 9th, 2025, for expansion pass owners. Check out the details below:[/p][h2]NEW CONTENT (THE STORYBOOK VALE EXPANSION PASS OWNERS):[/h2][list][*][p]Return to the Vale and descend into The Unwritten Realm, a void of swirling storybook pages – the place where stories go when they're forgotten and come from before they're written! Discover Maleficent and help her avoid being unwritten![/p][/*][*][p]Venture into the pages of a storybook to uncover Aurora in an enchanting Dream Style in addition to her regular look.[/p][/*][*][p]Help Maleficent and Aurora settle into the Vale and complete their friendship questlines to unlock stunning new items and outfits inspired by their malevolent and benevolent ways.[/p][/*][*][p]Equip your latest Royal Tool and harness the power of the Royal Net to catch new evasive Snippets – living embodiments of the Lorekeeper’s scattered pages.[/p][/*][*][p]Use new and original Snippets to complete these new challenging Lorekeeper Tales - tapestries that tell the stories of classic Disney and Pixar films.[/p][/*][*][p]Discover what Maleficent and Hades have hidden up their sleeves.[/p][/*][*][p]Team up with new allies to put a stop, once and for all, to these villainous schemes and save the Vale.[/p][/*][*][p]New special premium shop bundles sold in Moonstones inspired by Aurora and Maleficent will be available for ALL players![/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]TOP CHANGES AND BUG FIXES (AVAILABLE TO ALL PLAYERS):[/h2][list][*][p]Fixed an issue in the "Teapot Falls Trial" where chairs could not be moved into their proper placement.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue in the "Mistress of All Evil" quest where furniture could not be placed where needed.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the player would not receive a reward for reaching max level with the Forgotten.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue in the 'Healing House' quest where Mirabel won't go to Player's house[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where holding the direction arrow while attempting to switch to diagonal mode prevents the mode from updating.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where NPCs may sit in the air near the Peter Pan House.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where closing a purchase prompt in the shop would scroll the menu up to a different section.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where NPC's with animations that interact with flowers would not have a cooldown.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue in Photomode where the controller's focus shifts to the poses tab row instead of selecting the Sprint pose.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where some small vertical lines would appear in the Photomode menu.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where items cannot be marked as favorite or hidden via touchscreen when there is more than one item in the catalog.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Discover the Mysteries of Skull Rock Update!
notes.content: [p]Hey Valley Villagers![/p][p]Arrrr you ready to embark on your next Valley Adventure? [i]Disney Dreamlight Valley[/i]’s latest free update, the Mysteries of Skull Rock, arrives today on all platforms.[/p][p]Set sail to build friendships with two Villagers, dive into another seasonal Star Path, and uncover a bounty of upgrades for your Companions![/p][previewyoutube="fSW_PWO_TWw;full"][/previewyoutube][h2]Kindle ‘Forgotten’ Friendships[/h2][p]For those of you who have completed the main questline of the [i]Disney Dreamlight Valley [/i]base game, the story continues with new quests with The Forgotten.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42317391/4ffcd03e1c34932ccc93ba9ac1f953c76533b12a.png"][/img][/p][p]Freely roaming about your Valley, they have discovered a special feather that jogs their memories regarding Skull Rock. You'll need to help them think of the happiest things, and even gain a real name - all culminating in discovering a way into the iconic Dazzle Beach locale.[/p][h2]Step into Skull Rock![/h2][p]Once inside, you’ll uncover a massive cavern with a ship at its center. But, before you can find the treasures it holds, Puzzling Pixie Flames await, challenging you with manipulating lights and shadows to navigate your way around the cave.[/p][p]After working together, you’ll be able to give The Forgotten a less (or more) edgy name and work through friendship quests with them, all with new rewards.[/p][p]But, that’s not the only Villager to join your Valley in the Mysteries of Skull Rock update. From Disney’s [i]Peter Pan[/i], the boy who loves to fly – Peter, himself, joins you![/p][p]That said, you’ve done a little bit of growing up since last you played – and you’ll need to convince him you are the friend that he remembers, ie. [i]not a pirate[/i].[/p][p]This [i]may[/i] involve capturing a pesky shadow that doesn’t stay underfoot – but wins you a friend who arrives with his own house – er, hideout – and leads to Peter restarting the Valley’s ‘Dreamlight Lost Kids’![/p][h2]The Adventures in Neverland Star Path[/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42317391/eb49b0282c31024d5b1a9d2f024a009739209e8b.png"][/img][/p][p]Craving even more magic and adventure? Believe in the magic of wishful thinking and soar into the Adventures in Never Land Star Path! Catch fish on Dazzle Beach, find long-forgotten Memories, and spend time with the leader of the Lost Boys, Peter Pan! You'll be rewarded with swashbuckling styles, mystical mermaid cosmetics, unique pixie-inspired decor for your Valley, and more. [/p][h2]Companions[/h2][p]Peter Pan and the Forgotten aren’t the only two arriving with friendship rewards![/p][p]Your companions will now feature their own leveling track, and even special abilities once equipped. Learn more about what each creature brings to your hangout experiences in our [url="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1401590/view/823709285684877629"]Patch Notes[/url]![/p][h2]Valley Events[/h2][p]Grab your shovels and look out for where ‘X’ might mark a spot – the new event ‘Troves of Treasures’ arrives in July bringing nautical furniture designs perfect for a pirate ship.[/p][p]The Summer Sizzle event returns in August – arriving with sweet treats, and new rewards.[/p][h2]Community-Driven Features[/h2][p]Your comments and feedback always has us thinking “happy thoughts” – and inspired the following features and improvements arriving in this update:[/p][list][*][p]Gone are the days of receiving coins from picking up Memory Shards! [b]Complete your Memories faster[/b] by ensuring you gain a Memory Shard from each orb you interact with.[/p][/*][*][p]Path here, there, and everywhere with the introduction of [b]Diagonal Pathing![/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Cross-Save arrives for PlayStation[/b]! Play your save on all supported devices with this much requested update.[/p][/*][/list][p]----[/p][p]We can’t wait for you to befriend The Forgotten, Peter Pan, and your companions, and discover all that the Mystery of Skull Rock update has to offer. Don’t forget to connect with us on our official social media to share your in-game adventures with us by tagging us in your content![/p][p][b]Instagram[/b]: [url="https://gmlft.co/DDV-Instagram"]https://gmlft.co/DDV-Instagram[/url][/p][p][b]X[/b]: [url="https://gmlft.co/DDV-X"]https://gmlft.co/DDV-X[/url][/p][p][b]Facebook[/b]: [url="https://gmlft.co/DDV-Facebook"]https://gmlft.co/DDV-Facebook[/url][/p][p][b]YouTube[/b]: [url="https://gmlft.co/DDV-YouTube"]https://gmlft.co/DDV-YouTube[/url][/p][p][b]TikTok[/b]: [url="https://gmlft.co/DDV-TikTok"]https://gmlft.co/DDV-TikTok[/url][/p][p][/p][p]As always, should you run into any issues while playing [i]Disney Dreamlight Valley[/i], we first recommend that you check out our known issues [url="https://trello.com/b/WY5gDde3/disney-dreamlight-valley-issue-tracker-board"]here[/url]. If you don’t see the issue you’re running into, you can get in touch with our Support team via [url="https://gameloft.helpshift.com/hc/en/66-disney-dreamlight-valley/"]our contact form[/url]. Stumped with a certain quest or objective? Check out our friendly [url="https://discord.com/invite/disneydreamlightvalley"]Discord Community[/url] for some [i]Disney Dreamlight Valley [/i]tips and tricks![/p][p]See you in the Valley![/p]

notes.title: Mysteries of Skull Rock Update Patch Notes
notes.content: [p]Hey Valley Villagers! [/p][p]We hope you enjoyed uncovering what the rest of 2025 holds, along with a preview of the [b]Mysteries of Skull Rock[/b] free update in our latest [url="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=VLxIktZ3p4Q"]Developer Update video[/url]! From an exciting new roadmap to the arrival of [i]Disney Dreamlight Valley[/i]: The Storybook Vale Expansion Pass Part 2 on July 9th, there’s so much magic and adventure we can’t wait for you to explore.[/p][p]Today, we are giving you a closer look at the mysteries awaiting you in [i]Disney Dreamlight Valley’s[/i] next free update, detailed below in these patch notes.[/p][p]Get ready to explore the Mysteries Skull Rock, and rekindle your friendship with the Forgotten to welcome the new youthful Villager from Disney’s [i]Peter Pan[/i]! Unveiling the secrets of the mysterious rock will lead you to Peter – though his shadow might have its own plans for your Valley. Sail with us into a sea of wonders to uncover what awaits![/p][p]Disney Dreamlight Valley’s Mysteries of Skull Rock Update arrives on June 18, 2025, so check out the details below:[/p][h2]NEW CONTENT [/h2][list][*][p]It's time to continue the story of the Forgotten and explore the depth of Skull Rock to find out what, and more importantly who, is hiding there![/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Stepping out of Skull Rock, Peter Pan joins your Valley with spirited Friendship rewards and Quests. Convince him you’re not a treacherous pirate and progress in his questline to help him re-start his crew of Dreamlight Lost Boys![/p][/*][*][p]Prepare to warmly welcome the Forgotten as a true Villager, unlocking the ability to hang out as well as new friendship items. You’ll even be able to give them a name, to make them feel right at home in your Valley![/p][/*][*][p]Believe in the magic of wishful thinking with the Adventures in Never Land Star Path! Spend time with Peter Pan and complete various tasks to collect outfits inspired by Pirate and Mermaid fashions, unique decor and cosmetics, and unlock new Dream Styles for Goofy and Minnie.[/p][/*][*][p]Valiant treasure seekers, your time has come! Find special treasure maps around your Valley, solve riddles, and earn amazing rewards with the new Troves of Treasure Event.[/p][/*][*][p]Speaking of treasures, be sure to check in on the Scrooge McDuck’s Store each day for the chance to find new items.[/p][/*][*][p]What’s sweet, best enjoyed by a campfire, and tastes like summer? You got it, marshmallows! The Summer Sizzle Event arrives in your Valley – bringing back marshmallows, tasty treats and new rewards this season.  [/p][/*][*][p]Sail to exciting summer adventures with the weekly DreamSnaps challenges arriving in Mysteries of Skull Rock![/p][/*][*][p]New optional items are coming to the Premium Shop for a limited time, including a unique River Kit bundle that allows you to create your own waterway. But there is more! A new Companion Bundle arrives, introducing Max from Disney’s [i]The Little Mermaid[/i] as an Animal Companion. This adorable canine will not only follow you on your adventures but also help dig holes nearby thanks to his exclusive ability. The Max Bundle also includes a variety of nautical furniture item for you to enjoy![/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted available seasonal Moonstone packs that will be offered for a limited time. Different seasonal cosmetic items may be offered with future updates.[/p][/*][/list][p][i]* Please note: Disney Dreamlight Valley Arcade Edition does not include seasonal Star Paths or the Premium Shop.[/i][/p][p][i] [/i][/p][h2]IMPROVEMENTS [/h2][h3]COMPANION FRIENDSHIP:[/h3][p]Gather your furry, scaly, and feathered pals – friendship levels are here! Spend time and interact with your companions to level them up and get rewards. Bring companions along to collect bonus resources – each kind of companion will pick-up a specific type of resource:[/p][list][*][p]Squirrels will help with Fruits[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Rabbits will help with Vegetables[/p][/*][*][p]Turtles will help with Seafood[/p][/*][*][p]Sunbirds will help with Flowers[/p][/*][*][p]Foxes and Crocodiles will help with Fish[/p][/*][*][p]Raccoons and Whimsical Creatures will help with Gems[/p][/*][*][p]Ravens will help with Soils[/p][/*][*][p]Capybaras, Snakes, and Monkeys will help with Timebending Parts[/p][/*][*][p]Owls, Baby Dragons, and Pegasuses will help with Snippets[/p][/*][*][p]Dogs will help with sticks[/p][/*][/list][p]Some companions, especially notable named Disney companions, may not fit conventional categories and may bring special reward once you reach max friendship.[/p][p]But that’s not all! Depending on their level of friendship, companions can help expand your player inventory and provide extra resources when equipped to your Avatar. As a cherry on top, you can now give a unique nickname to any regular critter that doesn’t already have a preset name, making them truly your own. Additionally, all companions will now appear in a dedicated section of the Collections Menu – perfect for keeping track of your loyal sidekicks![/p][h3]DECORATING[/h3][list][*][p][b]Path Improvements[/b]: Unleash your creativity with an update to Paths, allowing you to place tiles diagonally! Seamlessly switch between Straight & Diagonal Modes for even more design flexibility and unique builds.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Grid Update: [/b]Explore new decorating possibilities with an expanded grid! More tiles will give you greater flexibility to place furniture items and customize your Valley in Decoration Mode.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Player House Style Improvements:[/b] Your favorite House, everywhere you go! A unique House Styles can now also be placed outside of your Valley, once in each Expansion area – and even on one of your Floating Islands![/p][/*][/list][p] [/p][h3]OTHER[/h3][list][*][p][b]New Photo Mode Improvements[/b]: You might need to sit to hear this 🪑... Photo Mode is getting additional enhancements in this update, including the option to sit while taking photos and new retouching options and toggles to perfect your shots![/p][/*][*][p][b]Memory Improvements[/b]: Complete memories faster! Updates to the shards balancing ensure you now receive a new Memory Shard every time you get a memory orb when participating in activities around your Valley – unless you've already completed all memories related to that activity. Plus, there are now more chances to obtain memory orbs when watering dried flowers![/p][/*][*][p][b]More Recommended Bundles[/b]: The Premium Shop recommended tab will now feature 6 bundles, giving you even more chances to discover items that match your style.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Uncrafting Station Balancing Fix[/b]: Corrected the Dreamlight cost of uncrafting certain items at the Uncrafting Station - such as paths - making it easier and less costly to reclaim materials.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Cross Save Update: [/b]Cross Save is finally arriving for PlayStation users alongside Mysteries of Skull Rock![/p][/*][/list][p] [/p][h2]TOP CHANGES AND BUG FIXES [/h2][list][*][p]Fixed an issue in the “Furniture Fluster” quest where the tulip vase could be spawned in an unreachable place.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue in the “Furniture Fluster” quest where the player may not be able to pick up the third piece of furniture (red bench) in Daisy's house.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue in the “Mannequin Madness” quest where the mannequin could disappear.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue in the “Books with No Pictures” quest where The Pop Up book disappeared.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue in “The Spark of Imagination” quest where the quest could become stuck in a loop.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where a house skin could appear inside the player's house.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the player would not be able to remove items from the Flower Play Table furniture.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue in the “Mannequin Madness” quest where the Cheshire Cat Slippers would not register as purchased for some players.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the player could be prevented from crafting tea cups.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the player may not be able to put ingredients into the cooking pot.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the “Lost and Found” message contains more items than can fit in the inventory. Therefore, the message can't be claimed.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where, for some players, the build Aladdin and Jasmine's house step doesn't register as completed.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue in the “Monkey Business” quest where the "Pick up the gemstones” step is not recognized.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue in “Chaos in the kitchen” quest where players could become stuck on 3/4 messes cleared.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the “Spirit Water Curtain” color would not remain the chosen one.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue in the “Teeny, Tiny Problems” quest where the "use the contrary perfume near the tea table" step can't be completed as the contrary perfume cannot be interacted with.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where rugs could become stuck in the Bind biome.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue in the Cheshire Chaos event where a Memory Shard could become stuck in a tree.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where Alice can remain smaller or bigger than normal if interrupting her animation. [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue with the minimum Dreamlight cost of using the Uncrafting Station.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue in Photomode where camera movement is not blocked when scrolling retouching options.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where Cheshire Cat's eye becomes blurred in a specific pose on his tree.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a visual issue where the bed in Alice's House would flicker on iOS iPhone and iPad.[/p][/*][*][p]Various clothing clipping fixes.[/p][/*][*][p]Audio bug fixes and improvements.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: The Dreamlight Parks Fest returns!
notes.content:
Hey Valley Villagers!

Dreaming of building – or expanding – your very own magical theme park? The Dreamlight Parks Fest in-game event is back, so get your cupcakes ready and join the celebration!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42317391/fe1621903422dd6f6d259305298bb903e743cbc0.png[/img]
From May 28th, 2025, to June 17th, 2025, collect buttons and complete quests to unlock Disney Parks-inspired prizes to decorate your Valley. This year’s festival is popping with extra fun! Enjoy increased chances to obtain Blue Buttons and new sweet rewards, including seven wearable Popcorn Buckets to top off your look.

[h2]How to Participate[/h2]
Take part in harvesting, fishing, crafting, and complete Villagers' requests around your Valley to obtain these colorful Buttons:
[list]
[*] 1 [b]Red Button[/b] will appear every 6 minutes around or inside Villager houses, with a maximum of 10 present at once.
[*] Found while fishing in the Peaceful Meadow and Dazzle Beach, 1 [b]Blue Button[/b] can be obtained from a special pink and blue ripple in each biome. While these event fishing spots will respawn every 30 seconds, you may occasionally find Blue Buttons in regular white or blue ripples.
[*] Found around the Plaza and Peaceful Meadow, 5 [b]Flower Buttons[/b] will appear every 30 minutes, with a maximum of 10 present at once.
[*] [b]Purple Buttons[/b] can be crafted at a crafting station using Red and Blue Buttons you've previously collected.
[*] You will be rewarded with [b]Green Buttons[/b] by completing daily and weekly quests. Make sure to check in regularly to complete a daily quest, granting you 20 Green Buttons. 
[/list]
Some Villagers will be counting on you to whip up something delicious! Each day, you’ll receive a quest from one of Scrooge McDuck, Ursula, WALL·E, Mickey Mouse, or Moana calling for some cupcake baking and delivering. Keep an eye out for your daily baking session to secure those Green Buttons!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42317391/07a0a5259a93c0c831300e0563dc5c908bb55f1f.png[/img]
Once you've collected enough Buttons, head to any crafting station to create charming Popcorn Buckets that are sure to add a touch of sweetness to your Valley. But that’s not all! Additional Disney Parks-inspired furniture will be available, so be sure to gather other crafting materials along the way – they just might come in handy.

[h2]New This Year[/h2]
If you’ve already participated in past Dreamlight Parks Fest events, don’t forget to check in with Scrooge McDuck and Mirabel, who’ll have new festive quests to offer. Complete various tasks with them to unlock two new prizes – a Minecart Popcorn Bucket and a Dug Pupcorn Bucket – sure to find a spot in your bucket collection.

Looking for the perfect accessory to explore your theme park in style? Take part in Dreamlight Parks Fest activities to unlock 7 new achievements, each rewarding you with a cute wearable Popcorn Bucket.

Enjoy the festival, and see you in the Valley!

notes.title: May 06 Hotfix Patch Notes
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42317391/2465f805c21e5a0d02bd47e46bdab8319bd5900b.png[/img]

Hey Valley Villagers!

Following up on our recent “Wonderland Whimsy” update, we’ve been monitoring your feedback and are happy to confirm an update today that addresses many of the top bugs and issues we’ve seen our Community members reporting.

Thank you to everyone who has shared their feedback with us thus far! Your input not only helps us prioritize critical issues but also helps us in identifying where gameplay features can be further enhanced.

Please find the details of the contents of the hotfix below:

[h1]BUG FIXES AND OTHER IMPROVEMENTS:[/h1]

[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where the Heavy Iron Cauldron furniture does not glow green and is empty.
[*] Fixed an issue where the crafting screen would be blank and the player would become soft locked.
[*] Fixed an issue where the game could soft lock when interacting with Cheshire's Smiles.
[*] Fixed an issue where the Garden Party Minnie and Garden Party Daisy are missing their Dreamlight sparkles effect.
[*] Fixed an issue where the Jasmine hairstyle was floating up behind the player when running. 
[*] Fixed an issue in the Storybook Vale expansion where one of the cutscenes had no sound.
[*] Fixed an issue where a motif from the Garden of Whimsy Star Path had stretched lines on all sides when applied. 
[*] Fixed an issue with the Sweet Strawberry Dress where it would deform on most masculine body types.
[*] Fixed an issue where the 'Purple Forest Fairy Lantern' would have broken VFX in its preview.
[*] Fixed some clipping issues on the Garden Party Daisy skin.
[*] Fixed an issue in "The Now and Then" quest where the projector would not spawn.
[*] Fixed an issue during the "On a Wild Cheshire Chase" quest where the 'Spoiled Milk' could fall in an unreachable place.
[*] Fixed an issue where furniture would be missing from certain Villager's houses before the "Furniture Fluster" quest begins.
[*] Fixed an issue in "The Now and Then" quest where a fishing ripple could spawn too close to the beach to be fixed in.
[*] Fixed an issue where the Event Menu would be reached with the directional pad without tracking any quests which could prevent players from selecting between seeds in the seed menu.
[*] Fixed an issue where the voice over was missing for languages other than English on Apple tvOS – Apple tvOS specific.
[*] Fixed an issue where some players on MacOS were not receiving their purchased packs – MacOS specific.
[/list]
___________________
Want to stay up to date on all things Disney Dreamlight Valley? Be sure to follow us on our social media channels:
[list]

[*] X: https://gmlft.co/DDV-X

See you in the Valley!

notes.title: Discover the Wonderland Whimsy Update!
notes.content:
Hey Valley Villagers!

Curious, and curiouser adventures await you in [i]Disney Dreamlight Valley[/i]’s latest free update – Wonderland Whimsy – now available on all platforms.

Take a tumble down a rabbit hole and uncover a new Realm, 2 new Villagers, and MORE!

[previewyoutube=3XeSLMXeNXk;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]A new Realm door opens…[/h2]

…in an unexpected way! Head to the Dream Castle to kickstart your journey into the [i]Alice in Wonderland[/i] Realm – where you’ll meet two familiar faces from Disney’s [i]Alice in Wonderland[/i]. 
Inside, not-so-impossible tasks  with Alice – who needs your help freeing animals from the Queen’s garden. Sure to earn a grin from ear-to-ear, your quest will also have you interacting with Cheshire Cat – though, his help… er, hijinks, might slow down your pace in navigating all of the Realm’s peculiar places.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42317391/807ab92e0961c694db5460d5d668b4bcf7148ce1.png[/img] 

Once you’re sure no one will lose their head once you leave, return to your Valley and welcome Alice as a Villager right away – although, it seems that Cheshire Cat has just a few some tricks up his figurative sleeves, requiring a little more time and finesse to fully integrate him in your Valleys. For more details on how and when to unlock him, see below – light spoilers ahead!
[list]
[*] After finishing up the [i]Alice in Wonderland[/i] Realm quests, keep an eye out for mischievous-looking mannequins. Check in with Scrooge McDuck to learn more!
[*] Starting on April 30th, expect Cheshire Cat to cook up some more trouble.
[*] Starting on May 7th, Cheshire Cat will be up to something fishy.
[*] After May 7th, all players will be able to complete Cheshire Cat’s welcoming quests right away.
[/list]
[i]*Note that dates above are reliant on the device clock/local time.[/i]

[h2]The Garden of Whimsy Star Path[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42317391/2bf7ef0bcbf734d7e3a05b50f6103dcc99656416.png[/img]

A brand-new seasonal Star Path brings a collection of Victorian and fairy-inspired fashions, tea-riffic essentials for the ultimate unbirthday party, and elegant Dream Styles for both Minnie Mouse and Daisy Duck.

[h2]New Premium Shop Content[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42317391/91d7df1b6896e9fd227671b87cfb11a68497bb18.png[/img]

New Premium Shop content arrives this season from a galaxy far, far away! 
Expect furniture and fashion inspired by Star Wars – including an iconic handheld accessory with unique photo mode poses. Make sure to grab yours in-game in time to celebrate [i]Star Wars[/i] day on May 4th! 
[i]* Please note: Disney Dreamlight Valley Arcade Edition does not include seasonal Star Paths or the Premium Shop.[/i]

[h2]Valley Events[/h2]

Cheshire Cat couldn’t arrive in the Valley without bringing along his own curious brand of chaos! Expect a new in-game event in May where you’ll need to keep an eye out for ‘Cheshire-fied’ items.
The magic of Disney Parks returns to the Valley with the return of the Dreamlight Parks Fest Event! Including new rewards and updates to daily quests, look forward to more news about this event later in the season.

[h2]Gameloft turns 25![/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42317391/81de1ff9065379ba1e2eac27085fecd7385311e4.png[/img]

Our team at Gameloft is celebrating our 25th anniversary! Check your mailbox in-game anytime from April 23-April 30 to claim free gifts to celebrate and mark this special milestone.

[h2]Community-Driven Features[/h2]

In addition to all the whimsy we’ve packed into this free update, we’ve also included more than a few dashes of wonder – in the form of features and improvements inspired by your feedback!
[list]
[*] [b]Snap the perfect pic[/b] …with Photo Mode improvements! Two more poses arrive in addition to new toggles to control a variety of elements like time and weather.
[*] [b]The Uncrafting Station arrives![/b] Teased on April Fools, unlock a new station that breaks down crafted items for a small Dreamlight cost – once you've welcomed Cheshire Cat and have progressed through his Friendship Quests.
[*] [b]Store more![/b] ...with updates to crafted chests! You can now upgrade small and medium-sized chests to maximize their storage potential.
[/list]
---
We can’t wait for you to explore the [i]Alice in Wonderland[/i] Realm, befriend Alice and Cheshire Cat, and discover all that the Wonderland Whimsy update has to offer. Don’t forget to connect with us on our official social media to share your in-game adventures with us by tagging us in your content!

[list]
[*] Instagram: https://gmlft.co/DDV-Instagram
[*] X: https://gmlft.co/DDV-X
[*] Facebook: https://gmlft.co/DDV-Facebook
[*] YouTube: https://gmlft.co/DDV-YouTube
[*] TikTok: https://gmlft.co/DDV-TikTok
[/list]

As always, should you run into any issues while playing Disney Dreamlight Valley, we first recommend that you check out our known issues [url=https://trello.com/b/WY5gDde3/disney-dreamlight-valley-issue-tracker-board]here[/url]. If you don’t see the issue you’re running into, you can get in touch with our Support team via [url=https://gameloft.helpshift.com/hc/en/66-disney-dreamlight-valley/]our contact form[/url]. Stumped with a certain quest or objective? Check out our friendly [url=https://discord.com/invite/disneydreamlightvalley]Discord Community[/url] for some Disney Dreamlight Valley tips and tricks!
See you in the Valley!

notes.title: Wonderland Whimsy Update Patch Notes
notes.content:
Hey Valley Villagers!

We are delighted to have given you a first look at the Wonderland Whimsy free update in our latest [url=https://youtu.be/3XeSLMXeNXk]Developer Update[/url] video series! Today, we are sharing an even closer look with these patch notes. 

Get ready to journey into a new Realm, inspired by Disney’s [i]Alice in Wonderland[/i]! On this new adventure, you’ll meet Alice herself and the mischievous Cheshire Cat, who will bring his unique quirks (and a little chaos) to your Valley. Jump down the rabbit hole with us to get this par-tea started!

[i]Disney Dreamlight Valley[/i]’s Wonderland Whimsy update launches on April 23, 2025, so let’s hop right to it!

[h2]NEW CONTENT[/h2]
[list]
[*] A new Realm door opens... but in a way you may not expect! Make your way to the newest door in the Dream Castle to kick off your whimsical adventure in the [i]Alice in Wonderland Realm[/i]. 
[*] Alice joins your Valley, bringing with her a series of delightful Friendship Quests and rewards—such as the Talkative Doorknob Door!
[*] Cheshire Cat will also join your Valley... but not without causing a bit of trouble in the weeks following the update.
[*] The Uncrafting Station arrives! Once you've welcomed Cheshire Cat to your Valley, progress through his Friendship Quests to unlock this exciting station that allows you to break down crafted items into their components for a small Dreamlight cost.
[*] Spring is officially here with the arrival of the new Garden of Whimsy Star Path. Collect a variety of clothing inspired by Victorian and fairy fashions, host your own tea party with new furniture items, and unlock new Dream Styles for Minnie Mouse and Daisy Duck!
[*] Riddle me this: Who has a mischievous grin and leaves behind a trace of chaos? Why, Cheshire Cat, of course! Participate in the new Cheshire Cat Chaos Event to unlock playful rewards later this season.
[*] Dreamlight Parks Fest returns! Get ready to bring the fun and wonder of Disney Parks to your Valley with this updated event—including new rewards and increased chances to obtain event materials. 
[*] New weekly DreamSnaps challenges arriving in this update are sure "tea leave" you delighted!
[*] Speaking of delights, be sure to check in on Scrooge McDuck’s Store every day for the chance to find new items.
[*] There’s new Premium Shop content this season—including a special collection arriving from a galaxy far, far away, just in time for you to celebrate May the 4th in style.
[*] We adjusted available Moonstone packs, which will be offered for a limited time, and different seasonal cosmetic items may be offered in future updates.
[/list]
[i]Please note: Disney Dreamlight Valley Arcade Edition does not include seasonal Star Paths or the Premium Shop.[/i]

[h2]IMPROVEMENTS[/h2]
[h3]UNCRAFTING:[/h3]
Reuse, Reduce, Uncraft! Use the Uncrafting Station to un-craft non-quest crafted items and recycle materials. This feature will be unlocked after welcoming Cheshire Cat to your Valley and progressing through his Friendship Quests. 
[h3]OTHER:[/h3]
Not done yet! Wonderland Whimsy has a couple more unbirthday party gifts for you (or your actual birthday, if the timing lines up!).
[list]
[*] [b]Upgradable Chests[/b]: Need more storage? Now you’ll be able upgrade Small and Medium crafted chests. 
[*] [b]Photo Mode Improvements[/b]: Updates to Photo Mode will have you smiling from ear to ear! These include two new poses, and tons of revamped options, including toggles to add or remove specific elements to better help you create the perfect image or DreamSnaps entry!
[*] [b]Player's House Expansion Improvements[/b]: More home renovations are coming your way, including odd-numbered layouts that will give you even more flexibility to make your Dream(light) House.
[*] [b]Sub-Grid Update[/b]: Create the perfect tea party with an update to grids on tables, allowing better alignment—or maximizing the potential space on tables for a true feast.
[*] [b]Main Menu Update[/b]: The start menu has been updated! Expect a new background image in addition to news tiles to keep you up to date with everything happening in the Valley.
[/list]
[h3]TOP CHANGES AND BUG FIXES:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where the Scrooge McDuck Sign for Wishing Wells could be missing.
[*] Fixed an issue where the speed of items placed in the cooking receptacle when using the Cooking menu autofill was significantly slower in the Tales of Agrabah update.
[*] Fixed an issue where selecting 10x6, 6x8, or 10x8 room sizes in the central room of any House could make that House inaccessible after exiting. This issue also restricted access to the “Elevator” in Houses using these room sizes.
[*] Fixed an issue where Goofy’s Stall could disappear from the Bind Biomes.
[*] Fixed an issue with the quest “Here and There and Back Again” where placing the Lioness Statue in the wrong place could block progression.
[*] Fixed an issue with the quest “Ask Daisy” where the Advice Box did not spawn near Daisy’s House.
[*] Fixed an issue with the quest “Gaston’s Challenge” where the game might not recognize that the player had filled in the many holes Oswald left in the Glittering Dunes.
[*] Fixed an issue with the quest “The Timon Talk” where the game might not recognize the completion of the step in which you need to dig up the 3 chests for Donald and open them.
[*] Fixed an issue with the quest “The Adventures of Flynn Rider” where ordering an Ink and Quill did not register.
[*] Fixed an issue with the quest “Guts & Glory” where Hades could become stuck.
[*] Fixed an issue with the quest “Where’s Pumbaa?” where no quest icon would appear above the tree log.
[*] Fixed an issue with the quest “Good As Gold” where the player would spawn near their House after exiting Scrooge McDuck's Store after the heist through the main door.
[*] Additional fixes include addressing issues with the quest “The Infestation,” where the Night Mite Nests and Mega Night Mites would spawn in the incorrect place. These fixes also address a related quest issue where the quest tracker did not recognize the tonic being made.
[*] Additional fixes to the quest “A Tale of Stone and Fire” where Maui could get stuck on Dazzle Beach.
[*] Fixed an issue where "HaircutScrooge01" was missing its intended name, "Curly Bob."This cosmetic also received a small update to its look, and can now be found by all players in Scrooge McDuck's Store.
[*] Fixed an issue with Jasmine's Bubble Ponytail that was not animating/moving as intended when worn by an Avatar.
[*] Fixed a display issue with the Avatar when entering a room using the Ornate Blue Door.
[*] Fixed an issue where a “Merlin’s Sample” item could get stuck in the player’s Inventory.
[*] Fixed an issue where the player could not remove the Brave Bear Tapestry once placed.
[*] Fixed a display issue where the Heavy Iron Cauldron was empty.
[*] Fixed a display issue where the Grand Tree of Holiday Cheer was missing its intended animation.
[*] Fixed an issue where the intended number of Beige Tale Cone Flowers was not spawning.
[*] Fixed an issue in the [i]Aladdin[/i] Realm where some players choosing the “What should I do?” prompt from Jasmine received the response “This node will not be accessible to players.”

[*] Fixed new instances that caused players to receive “Initialization Error #101.”
[*] Fixed an issue where the game could crash when opening the mailbox when the language was set to Italian.
[*] Fixed an issue where Jasmine gives the Desert Bloom Necklace as a Friendship Gift but it looks exactly like the Desert Protection Amulet the player gets in the Realm.
[*] Fixed an issue where the Avatar's hands are covered in stretched spots when wearing any pair of Socks along with the Villainous Elegance Gloves.

[*] Fixed a display issue causing all Cobra critters/companions to feature red eyes instead of their intended colors.
[*] Fixed a display issue where the Bing Bong Candy Stand featured unintended pink textures.
[*] Fixed an issue where one of WALL·E's animations would not play correctly on stairs and ramps.

notes.title: Celebrate Spring with the Eggstravaganza Event!
notes.content:
Hey Valley Villagers! 

Longer days, blooming flowers, and… eggs? It’s time to celebrate Spring with the return of the Eggstravaganza in-game event! 

[previewyoutube=RomIipalSDg;full][WIP Eggstravaganza Marketing Video] [/previewyoutube]

From April 2nd, 2025, to April 22nd, 2025, search your Valley for a variety of colorful eggs to cook and craft with to unlock exclusive rewards. While Wild Spring Eggs, Spring V-EGG-etables, and Egg-cellent fruit from Egg Fruit bushes can be found in your Valleys, you’ll need to step into a few Realms to locate a new type of Egg this season. 

[b]How to Participate[/b] 

[list]
[*] Egg-hunting requires good observation skills, so stay on the lookout for these pastel prizes:  
[*] Found in the Valley Plaza, 3 Egg Fruit bushes will appear during the event period, each granting 3 Egg-cellent Fruit every 30 minutes. 
[*] Wild Spring Eggs will appear regularly every 30 minutes across all Valley Biomes – with a maximum of 10 present at once. 
[*] Think you’ve checked everywhere? Think again! New this year, head into the [i]Moana[/i], [i]Toy Story[/i], [i]Lion King[/i], [i]Beauty and Beast[/i], and [i]Mulan[/i] Realms – where you can expect to find a Purple Egg every 5 minutes. A maximum of 10 will be present at once across all Realms. 
[/list] 
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42317391/8b005fb5f0712e48a8df66f47e06f30d99c528fd.png[/img]

Be sure to also check in daily and weekly with WALL·E, who will share fun quests to help you collect useful event materials. Looking to relax after all that egg-hunting? Try crafting, cooking, and decorating with seasonal items and recipes - your egg-forts will contribute to seasonal Dreamlight Duties – netting you even more surprises! 

If you’ve already participated in past Eggstravaganza events, don’t forget to head into the Realms shared above to collect Purple Eggs. Take your haul over to the nearest Crafting Station to create 3 new seasonal items: a lovely Egg Hanging Chair, Egg-cellent Balloons, and Potted Spring Egg Trees – all sure to bring Spring’s charm to your Valley. 

Happy egg-hunting, and see you in the Valley!

notes.title: Spring into the Lucky You! Event
notes.content:
[h2]Hey Valley Villagers![/h2]

Spring has sprung in the Valley – bringing with it a brand new in-game event: Lucky You! 

[previewyoutube=EVT01O9R0qQ;full][/previewyoutube]
From March 10th, 2025 to March 17th, 2025, keep an eye out in all the Valley biomes for 3-leaf clovers. If you’re extra lucky, you may even stumble upon a 4-leaf clover! 

While these clovers will appear occasionally in your Valleys every 5 minutes (or 90 minutes for the 4-leaf variant), expect to see green on March 17th when the odds of finding 4-leaf clovers increase.
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42317391/379a5fa0cfd3600f5058cc3d7a933f60aa61fbb8.png[/img]
Of course, collecting all these clovers comes with a reward! Once you’ve obtained a couple of each, head over to your Crafting Station to add some color (other than green!) to your Valley with the End of the Rainbow Cauldron.

Lastly, check out the new Achievement in your Dreamlight Duties menu to complete – netting you another reward.

Happy clover hunting!

notes.title: Discover the Tales of Agrabah Update!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42317391/021b5059af5d80cff30cd321b49dfaecb0f82932.png[/img]
Hey Valley Villagers!

[i]Disney Dreamlight Valley[/i]’s first update of 2025, Tales of Agrabah, is now LIVE on all platforms! Swap out your winter sweaters for cooler wear, don your most stylish... or sneakiest (more on this, later!) sneakers, and get ready to dive into a new Realm, welcome 2 new Villagers, and MORE!

[previewyoutube=zXgZgPx17Rg;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]A whole new Realm to explore![/h3]
Adventure awaits you in the Dream Castle behind the latest Realm Door – inspired by Disney’s [i]Aladdin[/i]! Teleporting you to a market set in Agrabah, prepare your Avatar by dressing for the desert heat and… sandstorms?

Luckily for you, Jasmine is already on the case. Unfortunately for the market, a mysterious artifact has summoned strong winds that left unchecked will reduce everything to ruins! You’ll need to locate Aladdin in the Realm to uncover what he’s learned about the artifact – and through some clever use of your Royal Tools (and a little monkey-business), attempt to return things to normal. A familiar fabric friend will also lend you a hand, joining you as a companion once you leave the Realm!

Once you’ve ensured that the Realm has only sunny and storm-free days ahead, Aladdin and Jasmine will join your Valley as Villagers, with unique friendship questlines and splendid rewards. Jasmine will request your aid in rediscovering her memories of the Valley – culminating in taming some wishes gone wild! 
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42317391/c8fe0c10fea0957b095d1bdf61dc0e44d681846b.jpg[/img]
Scrooge McDuck has an interesting task to welcome Aladdin to the Valley and test your own skills – break into his vault! With a new security system in place, work together on your sneaking skills to solve a new stealth gameplay mechanic.

If sneaking is too slow for you – don’t worry! Glide through the Valley in style by crafting your very own Dreamlight Tapestry with Aladdin through his questline! 

[h3]Oasis Retreat Star Path[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42317391/a7b738956781fb8715b14acb424713245141b1e4.png[/img]
After a hard day unlocking a new Realm, chasing critters, and/or harvesting 100 pumpkins – kick back and relax with the Oasis Retreat Star Path!

With resort-inspired fashions, wicker décor, and a delightful capybara animal companion that exudes tranquility wherever it roams, create the oasis of your dreams! Bonus rewards also return – inclusive of a new wood and wicker House Dream Style.

Additional stock arrives in Scrooge McDuck’s Store this season, along with new optional content in weekly Premium Shop rotations. Saving your Moonstones, but don’t want to miss out on a deal? As of this update, you’ll be able to pin up to two non-owned bundles from the Premium Shop to purchase at a later date! 

[h3]Valley Events[/h3]
Looking for more in-game content? You’re in [i]luck[/i]! 
[list]
[*] The Eggstravaganza event returns with egg-cellent news: even. more. eggs! We’re introducing another color of egg to collect, and brand-new rewards.
[*] A new event will also arrive this season, bringing rainbows of color to your Valley (leaning green…!).
[/list]
Keep an eye on our social media accounts to learn more about these events in the near future.

[h3]Get cooking with Tiana![/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42317391/eb71b7aead9e9db83cf39b8564e7261390e5957f.png[/img]
If you’ve already unlocked Tiana, from Disney’s [i]The Princess and the Frog[/i], you’re in for a treat! 

It seems she has found schematics for a new item in the Dreamlight Library – a Slow Cooker! Crafting this culinary classic will enable you to cue up multiple meals for a small Dreamlight cost – ensuring you have plenty of meals for your next play session.

Hungry for more cooking upgrades? We’ve got you covered with our…

[h3]Community-Driven Features[/h3]
Our team revels in taking the opportunity to develop new features and build upon existing content, taking inspiration from player feedback! Read on to discover just a few of these changes arriving in the Tales of Agrabah update:

[b]The Search is over…[/b] for recipes! This update introduces a much-requested search bar to the Cooking menu – alongside other Cooking interface changes. Learn more in our update Patch Notes.

[b]Expand the horizon of your decorating[/b] with new Floating Islands! Islands inspired by the Peaceful Meadow, Dazzle Beach, Glade of Trust, and Forgotten Lands are available for you to explore and make your own – for a small Dreamlight cost.

[b]Feel more at home[/b] with updates to housing! You’ll now be able to remove mailboxes from secondary player houses, further customize the layout size of rooms in your main house AND secondary houses, and offset the center of wallpapers.
---
We can’t wait for you to explore the [i]Aladdin[/i]-inspired Realm, befriend Jasmine and Aladdin, and discover all that the Tales of Agrabah update has to offer. Don’t forget to connect with us on our official social media to share your in-game adventures with us by tagging us in your content!

[b]Instagram[/b]: [url=https://gmlft.co/DDV-Instagram]https://gmlft.co/DDV-Instagram[/url]
[b]X[/b]: [url=https://gmlft.co/DDV-X]https://gmlft.co/DDV-X[/url]
[b]Facebook[/b]: [url=https://gmlft.co/DDV-Facebook]https://gmlft.co/DDV-Facebook[/url]
[b]YouTube[/b]: [url=https://gmlft.co/DDV-YouTube]https://gmlft.co/DDV-YouTube[/url]
[b]TikTok[/b]: https://gmlft.co/DDV-TikTok


As always, should you run into any issues while playing [i]Disney Dreamlight Valley[/i], we first recommend that you check out our known issues [url=https://trello.com/b/WY5gDde3/disney-dreamlight-valley-issue-tracker-board]here[/url]. If you don’t see the issue you’re running into, you can get in touch with our Support team via [url=https://gameloft.helpshift.com/hc/en/66-disney-dreamlight-valley/]our contact form[/url]. Stumped with a certain quest or objective? Check out our friendly [url=https://discord.com/invite/disneydreamlightvalley]Discord Community[/url] for some [i]Disney Dreamlight Valley[/i] tips and tricks!

See you in the Valley!

notes.title: Tales of Agrabah Update Patch Notes
notes.content:
Hey Valley Villagers!

We are so happy to have given you a first look at the Tales of Agrabah free update in our latest [url=https://youtu.be/w14O6UlXpjk]Developer Update video[/url]! Today, we are sharing an even closer look in these patch notes. 

Prepare for your upcoming journey to the [i]Aladdin[/i]-inspired Realm, featuring an iconic duo (and their trusty Magic Carpet) and all the adventures and perks unlocked alongside them! Join us on a magical (carpet) ride to discover a whole new Realm - and more!

[i]Disney Dreamlight Valley[/i]’s Tales of Agrabah Update arrives on February 26th, 2025, so let’s dive in!

[h1]NEW CONTENT[/h1]

[list]
[*] A new Realm door opens! Travel to the Dream Castle and through the [i]Aladdin[/i] Realm door to arrive in Agrabah’s market inspired by Disney’s [i]Aladdin[/i].
[*] Aladdin and Jasmine join the Valley, bringing with them new Friendship Quests, and majestic Friendship Rewards!
[*] Through your Realm adventures, unlock a familiar flying carpet as a companion! 
[*] A variety of quests arrive to introduce you to brand-new stealthy gameplay mechanics, crafting your own Dreamlight Tapestry glider, and a gem stall! 
[*] Kick-back and relax in a retreat of your own making with the new Oasis Star Path. Unlock resort-inspired fashions, furniture, and even a few items for your animal companions!
[*] Spring into action with a new in-game event, and the return of Eggstravaganza! Search your Valley for clovers and eggs, craft and unlock unique rewards, and make WALL-E’s day.
[*] The weekly DreamSnap challenges in Tales of Agrabah will help you thaw off that Winter chill and kick start Spring!
[*] Speaking of Spring, keep an eye on new and returning Spring-themed merch in Scrooge McDuck’s store!
[*] Adjusted available Moonstone packs to introduce a new option that includes both Moonstones and a seasonal Valley inspired cosmetic item. This pack will be offered for a limited time and different seasonal cosmetic items may be offered with future updates.
[/list]
[i]Please note: Disney Dreamlight Valley Arcade Edition does not include seasonal Star Paths or the Premium Shop.
[/i]

[h1]IMPROVEMENTS[/h1]
[h2]COOKING:[/h2]
Hungry for more? With Tales of Agrabah, we’re also improving your cooking experience!
[list]
[*] Scroll no more! You can now locate any recipe with a new search bar!
[*] It’s now also easier to find meal requests, be they restaurant orders or quests, with new sorting tabs.
[*] What’s that? You want to cook more meals with less hassle? Yes chef! Queue up a variety of meals for a small Dreamlight cost with the all-new Slow Cooker!
[*] Save your rarer resources! Recipes with generic requirements will select suitable ingredients prioritizing the highest quantity of resources available.
[/list] 
[h2]UI:[/h2]
But wait, there’s more! Here are some UI changes that are sure to make life in the Valley easier.
[list]
[*] Inventory items will now display a tag as to where they are from, including the Valley and both Expansions.
[*] Items will also indicate if they are a Villager’s favorite gift of the day so you can be sure to not miss out on sharing gifting moments with them!
[/list]
[h2]OTHER:[/h2]
Nope, not done yet. More sweet new features! 
[list]
[*] Not one, but four new Floating Islands arrive in this update: Peaceful Meadow, Dazzle Beach, Glade of Trust and Forgotten Lands. 
[*] Never miss out on a deal with the option to pin two Premium Shop bundles! They will remain pinned until purchased, or you decide to swap them for something else.
[*] Expand your creativity indoors with new room size customization options.  You’ll also be able to remove/re-add rooms to secondary houses!
[*] You’ve got... less mail! This update introduces the option to remove mailboxes from secondary houses.
[*] Wallpapers will now feature the ability to offset the center of their designs, allowing for even more flexibility when interior decorating.
[/list] 

[h1]TOP CHANGES AND BUG FIXES:[/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where a squid placed on the ground could not be picked up.
[*] Fixed an issue where players couldn't reach certain parts of the Fallen Fortress.
[*] Fixed an issue where the "Catch Fish in Mythopia" Dreamlight Duty counter did not count.
[*] Fixed an issue where the Pegasus critter could disappear while being chased.
[*] Fixed an issue where Luminous Dance Flooring couldn't be removed from some areas once placed.
[*] Fixed an issue preventing some players from receiving DreamSnap rewards.
[*] Fixed an issue where rain would not appear.
[*] Fixed an issue where Mickey Mouse's sitting animation did not display correctly.
[*] Fixed instances causing players to receive “Initialization Error #101”.
[*] Fixed an issue where Crafting Stations did not appear in the Furniture menu.
[*] Fixed an issue where the First Frost Jacket and Spring Thaw Jacket were incorrectly categorized.
[*] Fixed an issue where Animal Companions placed in Animal Companion Houses on Floating Islands did not appear.
[*] Fixed some furniture assets that were incorrectly tagged or missing tags. 
[*] Fixed an issue where cut scenes and tutorial videos didn’t load correctly on Steam/Steam Deck.
[*] Fixed an issue where other buttons are not disabled during the Undo all confirmation pop up in Edit Mode.
[*] Fixed an issue where Snippets could collide with and push NPCs.
[*] Fixed an issue where the Gleam Balloon Arch furniture had 1 balloon of the wrong color out of place.
[*] Fixed an issue where the Avatar had no collision with part of the rock near the Sealed Cave entrance.
[*] Fixed an issue where the Onyx Crown was incorrectly available in Scrooge McDuck’s Store.
[*] Fixed an issue where the Red Drapery furniture item couldn’t be purchased from Scrooge McDuck’s Store.
[*] Fixed an issue where items could get stuck in the pillars on either side of the entrance inside Scrooge McDuck’s Store.
[*] Fixed an issue where items couldn't be removed from the Wintery Pond once placed.
[*] Fixed an issue where two clothing items were named “First Frost Dress”, “Icy Blue Gown” is now correctly named.
[*] Fixed an issue where some clothing could cause the Avatar to display incorrectly after quickly switching between certain clothing items. 
[*] Fixed an issue where the Pocket Watch and Bard's Cap items were in the wrong collection menu section.
[*] Fixed issues where some clothing would clip with the Avatar and other clothing items.
[*] Fixed an issue where items could spawn in the rocky wall section near the edge of Ariel's Beach area.
[*] Fixed an issue where the Archive Glade furniture item has a flame but no candle.
[*] Fixed an issue where the tags for the Frost & Fairies Star Path items were incorrect. 
[*] Fixed an issue where a bonus reward in the Frost & Fairies Star Path had a placeholder name.
[*] Fixed an issue where the game could freeze while collecting Star Path rewards.
[*] Fixed an issue where items could fall inside the Biome Blockers on the bridge between the Everafter and Mythopia Biomes.
[*] Fixed an issue where quest items placed on the Floating Island couldn’t be removed.
[*] “The Timon Talk” quest: Fixed an issue where a chest could get stuck behind a rock.
[*] “Old Enemies” quest: Fixed an issue that prevented the quest from progressing.
[*] “Down to Earth” quest: Fixed an issue where a misplaced Spare Telescope could not be picked up, blocking the quest’s completion.
[*] “Collect 'Em All: Attic Mode” quest: Fixed an issue where an Alien toy could get stuck in the cave.
[*] “The Old Enemies” quest: Fixed an issue where removing the trap did not progress the quest.
[*] “The Chronicles of the Ancients” quest: Fixed an issue where a placed table did not register in the quest steps.
[*] “Timon Talk” quest: Fixed an issues where the Unfortunate Fish Bones could not be picked up. 
[*] “Relax!” quest: Fixed an issue where it was not clear what Pumbaa's napping spots were and added VFX make this clearer.
[*] “A Moth to a Flame” quest: Fixed an issues where taking a photo of some blockers in the "Mysterious Flames Block the Path!” step in the Storybook Vale expansion did not progress the quest.
[*] “A Deal with Ursula” quest: Fixed an issue where the player might not have been able to place the 4th crystal.
[*] “The Company of the Wolf” quest: Fixed additional issues causing the buried items to land in an unreachable area.
[/list]

notes.title: December 12 Hotfix Patch Notes
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42317391/71e442e9ee9661adeb3f081e771fc9f95c0f16f1.png[/img]

Hey Valley Villagers!

Following the launch of our latest free update, “Sew Delightful”, our team has been diligently monitoring your feedback in the efforts of sharing a hotfix today to address issues prevalent within our Community.
 
We sincerely appreciate those who take the time to help us identify bugs and issues by sharing their feedback, whether it be a comment on a social media post, or a ticket with our Customer Care team.

For an overview of the resolutions included in this hotfix, please see below:

[h1]NEW CONTENT:[/h1]

[list]
[*] Added a recipe to Crafting Stations that players can use to convert Snippets into Storybook Magic.

[*] “The Woven Bridge” quest: Fixed an issue where a spiderweb can drop into an unreachable area.
[*] Fixed an issue in Reorder Stories where it was possible for players to become stuck if they rotated a piece at the same time as placing it.
[*] Fixed an issue where the 'Duty Completed' popup did not display the hotkey to navigate to the Dreamlight or Star Path menus.
[*] Fixed an issue where the menu highlight can be moved in the background when the 'More Tokens' popup is present on the screen in the Event menu. 
[*] Fixed an issue where the Sticky Traps could be placed in the base village and Eternity Isle.
[*] Fixed an issue where a memory would incorrectly ask for only 3 pieces to complete it.
[*] Fixed an issue where the Newspaper Dress did not appear as intended.
[*] Fixed an issue where players would receive all the mails for one of Pumbaa’s questlines all at once instead of in steps.

[*] Fixed an issue where players’ saves could be too large and cause an Initialization Error #1.
[*] Fixed an issue where the Winter Swing furniture is displayed larger than intended.
[*] Fixed an issue with the Edna Testing Machine furniture is positioned too low.
[*] Fixed an issue where too many NPCs could be loaded in the village causing lag.
[*] Fixed an issue where a part of the Fallen Fortress was inaccessible. 
[*] Fixed an issue where the Scramblecoin board could become covered in fog.
[*] Fixed an issue where the red notification dot would remain indefinitely on the events tab.
[*] Fixed an issue where some players would crash when entering their house when certain items were placed inside.
[*] Further fixes to remove additional dishes containing pork from Pumbaa’s restaurant and favorite gift requests.
