notes.title: Discover the Sew Delightful Update!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42317391/aed7c0d88ca5251b42ab6a23be73f1dba670b423.png[/img]
[h3]Hey Valley Villagers![/h3]

Ring in the winter season with [i]Disney Dreamlight Valley’s[/i] latest free update – Sew Delightful – now available on all platforms!

We hope you’re [i]thread[/i]-y to welcome a new Villager, dive into an un-brr-lievable Star Path and play with all new features and improvements. Read on to learn more!

[previewyoutube=E-kJpIb9CnI;full][VIDEO: UPD14 Trailer on YouTube][/previewyoutube]

[h2]Welcome a new friend![/h2]
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42317391/6165b8c05f67f8e77cd41bac9e34dd3f50d760b2.png[/img]

It seems like someone has spun messages around Kristoff’s home – although, he isn’t quite sure how to decipher them. The perfect task for the hero of the Valley (that’s you!) and the master of all things frightful (that’ll be Jack) – you’ll soon weave a way to welcoming a new Villager… but whom?

Just in time for the winter holiday season, but with more delights than Jack Skellington’s frights, Sally from Disney Tim Burton’s [i]The Nightmare Before Christmas[/i] joins the Valley! With her own set of friendship rewards, Sally brings a series of exciting quests involving preposterous premonitions and creating the perfect date night.

[h2]A new Star Path – with a twist![/h2]
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42317391/3be12124a97f2f1c139a8357cf2081e13e0f03ce.png[/img]

Live magically… or should we say ‘mag-ice-ally’ in this season’s Star Path: Frost & Fairies! Give your Villagers their favorites gifts, clear away Night Thorns, and complete Duties as fae royalty in your domain. Expect enchanting rewards such as a gleaming harp of ice and silk, a frozen throne, crystalline décor, and unique fairy fashions.

This season also introduces Bonus Rewards! Once you’ve completed the Premium tier of the Star Path, tackle another set of duties to claim variants of rewards, including a cozy Winter Cottage House Dream Style!

You can also expect additional stock in daily rotations in Scrooge McDuck’s Store as well as new optional content in weekly Premium Shop rotations.

[h2]Top DreamSnaps feature[/h2]
Get inspired by your fellow Valley Villagers with the Top DreamSnaps of the Week feature! View the top 3 images from each weekly challenge – ranked by the highest-scored points among eligible players.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42317391/e2b2cff774b67089188ecf9826f156bd2b506302.png[/img]

While we can’t wait to see what you create, you will have the option to opt in or out of this feature when you submit your image to each challenge. [i]Due to compliance with certain rules and standards, PlayStation players are not eligible to participate in this feature.[/i]

[h2]Do you want to craft a snowman?[/h2]
Festive in-game events return in this update – with updates to rewards and activities!

The Gift of Giving event brings unique crafting resources to your Valley with Festive Wrapping Paper appearing around Scrooge McDuck’s Store from December 18 to December 31. Use these to craft the perfect furniture for a holiday dinner with your Villagers – unless you find yourself busy fishing red and green ripples for Festive Fish!

In the mood for a cooler quest? Through December 18 to December 31, you’ll also want to check your Plaza for a chest that holds the first step towards crafting yourself a whimsical snow man.
And don’t forget to play between December 25 and December 31, visiting the Dream Castle for even 
more gifts under the Dreamlight Tree!

[h2]Community-driven Features[/h2]
Each update gives our team the opportunity to build upon and deliver new features inspired by our players’ feedback. We’d like to give a big shoutout to all who share their thoughts with us on every update – and showcase just a few of the highlights arriving in the Sew Delightful update inspired by players like you!
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42317391/cf3f03c20012682aa1197638f032f0904352f76b.png[/img]

[b]16-Point Rotation is here![/b] Rotate furniture, landscaping items, and resources such as flowers to your heart’s content! We can’t want to see how this update enhances your Valleys.
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42317391/8e2a97d3bc42652e3c92f5968154a420a36d06f2.png[/img]

[b]Take your decorating to the skies![/b] Floating Islands arrive in the Sew Delightful update, delivering 4 large spaces with their own unique decorating limits – challenging you to decorate them with themes based after the Valley’s Biomes. [url=https://disneydreamlightvalley.com/news/FloatingIslandExplainerBlog]Learn more here[/url].

[b]Say olá, or hello, with new language options![/b] As of the Sew Delightful update, [i]Disney Dreamlight Valley[/i] and [i]The Rift in Time[/i] and [i]The Storybook Vale[/i] are available in Brazilian Portuguese.

[hr][/hr]

We can’t wait for you to meet Sally, decorate your Valleys for the holidays, and discover all that the Sew Delightful update has to offer! Don’t forget to connect with us on our official social media to share your in-game adventures with us by tagging us in your content!
[list]
[*] Instagram: https://gmlft.co/DDV-Instagram
[*] X: https://gmlft.co/DDV-X
[*] Facebook: https://gmlft.co/DDV-Facebook
[*] YouTube: https://gmlft.co/DDV-YouTube
[*] TikTok: https://gmlft.co/DDV-TikTok
[/list]

As always, should you run into any issues while playing [i]Disney Dreamlight Valley[/i], we first recommend that you check out our known issues [url=https://trello.com/b/WY5gDde3/disney-dreamlight-valley-issue-tracker-board]here[/url]. If you don’t see the issue you’re running into, you can get in touch with our Support team via [url=https://gameloft.helpshift.com/hc/en/66-disney-dreamlight-valley/]our contact form[/url]. Stumped with a certain quest or objective? Check out our friendly [url=https://discord.com/invite/disneydreamlightvalley]Discord Community[/url] for some Disney Dreamlight Valley tips and tricks!

See you in the Valley!

notes.title: Sew Delightful Update Patch Notes
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42317391/d846cadb2a1f7fe46b8d020fba3a508a2a86a722.png[/img]

Hey Valley Villagers!
While it feels like just yesterday we were traveling to a new land in [i]Disney Dreamlight Valley: The Storybook Vale[/i] [url=https://disneydreamlightvalley.com/news/TheStorybookValeUpdate]Expansion Pass Part 1[/url], today we’re sharing all the details on [i]Disney Dreamlight Valley’s[/i] next free update!

Get ready to welcome a new Villager, take to the skies with Floating islands, and usher in the winter season with a new Star Path – alongside other improvements and resolutions to top issues.

[i]Disney Dreamlight Valley’s[/i] “Sew Delightful” Update arrives on December 4, 2024, so check out all the details below:

[h1]NEW CONTENT (AVAILABLE TO ALL PLAYERS):[/h1]

[list]
[*] A new character. Sally from Disney[i] Tim Burton’s The Nightmare Before Christmas[/i] joins the Valley, bringing her signature patchwork style to her friendship quest rewards!
[*] A new Star Path. Add some winter whimsy to your Valley with the Frost & Fairies Star Path. Dabble in fae fashions for your Avatar and decorate with crystalline furniture items and other enchanting rewards.
[*] Even more rewards await! Players who claim all items from the Free and Premium tracks of the Frost & Fairies Star Path can continue the fun in the Bonus Rewards tab, featuring color variants and other rewards. 
[*] The Gift of Giving event returns: collect Festive Wrapping Paper to create seasonal decorations and finish your festive fish collection with rare seasonal aquatic life.
[*] Do you want to craft a snowman? Alongside the Gift of Giving event, keep an eye out for a chest in your Plaza that will kick off a new seasonal task.
[*] New gifts under the seasonal tree! Make sure to play in late December to claim new seasonal surprises in the Dream Castle. 
[*] Weekly rotation galore – check in each week for new DreamSnaps themes to win Moonstones – and save them up for delightful new optional content arriving in the Premium Shop.
[*] Save up those Star Coins: Scrooge McDuck’s Store receives new stock for sale, featuring items inspired by Disney’s [i]The Lion King[/i], and others from Villager homes.
[*] Olá! [i]Disney Dreamlight Valley[/i] and[i] The Rift in Time[/i] and [i]The Storybook Vale[/i] will be available in Brazilian Portuguese as of the Sew Delightful update.
[/list]

[i]* Please note: Disney Dreamlight Valley Arcade Edition does not include seasonal Star Paths or the Premium Shop.[/i]

[h1]IMPROVEMENTS (AVAILABLE TO ALL PLAYERS):[/h1]

[h2]DREAMSNAPS:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added a new feature “Top DreamSnaps of the Week”. This showcase will feature the top 3 images in each weekly challenge, in order of the highest-scored points among eligible players who agreed to share the submissions. Players can choose to opt-out of this feature. Due to compliance with certain rules and standards, PlayStation players are not eligible to participate in this feature.
[/list]

[h2]OTHER:[/h2]
[list]
[*] 4 Floating Islands themed after the Plaza, Forest of Valor, Sunlit Plateau, and the Frosted Heights Biomes arrive! Learn more in our dedicated blog here: https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1401590/view/4463725203231345803 
[*] Give your Valley a new look with 16-point rotation! This feature allows players to rotate houses, landscaping items, and furniture to their heart’s content!
[*] Some pond-like furniture items (Relaxing Oasis and Watering Hole) will now feature some areas where water-based furniture and landscaping items can be placed. 
[/list]

[h1]TOP CHANGES AND BUG FIXES:[/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where non-bordered pathing displayed with a blunt North-most edge.
[*] Fixed an issue where some wall items displayed at the wrong angle in Scrooge McDuck’s Store or in player houses.
[*] Fixed an issue where Pumbaa requested pork-based recipes as gifts.
[*] Fixed an issue where some items were missing from the Collections menu.
[*] Fixed a variety of localization errors.
[*] Fixed an issue where the game may not display the current device time.
[*] Added an icon on Touch of Magic Storage furniture items in the menu to indicate if they have items in them.
[*] Fixed an issue where Mulan can step too close to the player during the Selfie Animation.
[*] Fixed an issue where NPC's may turn away from the player during a discussion.
[*] Fixed several visual issues and clipping with various clothing combinations.
[*] Improved the texture resolution on some items in Jack Skellington’s house on iOS.
[*] Fixed an issue where some dresses could become deformed when gliding.
[*] Fixed several furniture highlights in edit mode that would have a visual issue in the form of grey squares.
[*] Fixed an issue where the DreamSnaps menu would not load for some players.
[*] “The Drawings” quest: Intended as a ‘secret’ quest (similar to the “Keycard Pieces” quest in the [i]Monsters, Inc.[/i] Realm), a quest tracker pop-up causing confusing has been removed. 
[*] “A New Directive” quest: Fixed an issue where the BnL blanket would not spawn.
[*] “The Infestation” quest: Fixed an issue where the Night Mite Nests and Mega Night Mites would spawn in the incorrect places.
[*] “Archery and Archrivals” quest: Fixed an issue where players could not locate all of the Wanted Posters due to them spawning in unreachable areas.
[*] “The Company of the Wolf” quest: Fixed an issue where players could not located all of the buried items, or they spawned in unreachable areas or areas that could not be interacted with.
[*] “A Tale of Stone and Fire” quest: Fixed an issue where Maui would remain on Dazzle Beach.
[*] Added a popup on PlayStation to explain that when crossplay is disabled, DreamSnaps entries cannot be submitted.

[*] Various other bug fixes, optimizations and improvements.

notes.title: The sky’s the limit with Floating Islands!
notes.content:
[h3]Hey Valley Villagers![/h3]

While we are sure you’re busy discovering every nook and cranny of the Storybook Vale, additional exciting areas are soon to arrive for all [i]Disney Dreamlight Valley[/i] players as a part of our December 4 Sew Delightful update – Floating Islands! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42317391/e0f39dc24cc83bb2c5e52d932040ab693d30f1fc.png[/img] 

Featured in our 2024 Showcase Stream, you may have first noticed these islands floating in the skies above the Valley – inaccessible – until now!

Once you’ve completed the main story quest “What’s Left Behind”, check in with the Valley’s resident prognosticator Merlin, who has been researching the magical calculations required to connect the Wishing Wells found in each biome to those residing on the Floating Islands – starting off the quest “Islands in the Sky”.

Using a Wishing Well, or the Map Fast Travel Menu, you can access the first of these islands – themed after the Plaza! It seems like in addition to discovering a new space to practice your decorating skills, Merlin too has found an opportunity to move the Dreamlight Library to somewhere away from the hustle and bustle of the Valley… 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42317391/518c5a4d2c472d601c5a9f791bf2aabe8ea82194.png[/img]

After you’ve helped him out – the Plaza Floating Island becomes available to make your own – along with the 3 other islands, based off of some of the Valley’s other Biomes. Additional Floating Islands may be added in future updates – so stay tuned!

Using the Map Fast Travel Menu will allow you to unlock these additional islands, each costing 15,000 Dreamlight. With the exception of a Wishing Well, each features roughly 130x130 squares of decorating space – providing you with a blank canvas to express yourself! Each Floating Island also hosts its own decorating island limit – freeing up space in the Valley for additional decorations.

Will you house all your Villains on an island to keep an eye on them, or perhaps move your Avatar’s home, creating your personal paradise? The decision is yours, but, you won’t be alone! Your Villagers can be found visiting the Floating Islands, and players participating in a Valley Visit with you can also take in the sights of your island creations.

The Floating Islands feature will arrive for all players as a part of the Sew Delightful update, launching on December 4th. We can’t wait to see what you create with each new island canvas!

[hr][/hr]

See you in the Valley (and on a Floating Island)!

notes.title: Adventure Awaits in Disney Dreamlight Valley: The Storybook Vale Part 1!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42317391/f95d62d32b27c5707a627bd83373f64dcf5844c4.png[/img]
[h3]Welcome, Valley Villagers… to the Storybook Vale![/h3]

It’s time to crack open the latest chapter of [i]Disney Dreamlight Valley[/i] and make use of your Stardust Port once again—this time transporting you to an enchanted land where myths and fairytales spring to life.

[previewyoutube=odLqgITVDqI;full][/previewyoutube]
[h2]A New Chapter to Unfurl[/h2]
Once upon a time, the Storybook Vale existed in the skies above the Valley but was stolen away by Maleficent from Disney’s [i]Sleeping Beauty[/i] and Hades from Disney’s [i]Hercules[/i]. While they ruled peacefully for a time, conflict between the two marred the very fabric of the lands they ruled—causing ink to spill from the ground!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42317391/b71dab0edc3a654efaa548d8359392ee57b010cf.png[/img]
Whether you’ve foiled Jafar’s schemes in [i]Disney Dreamlight Valley: A Rift in Time[/i] or have triumphed over the events of the Forgetting in [i]Disney Dreamlight Valley[/i]—adventures await for all landing on the Vale’s shores. After you’ve gathered your Royal Tools from the Valley, a letter will arrive in your in-game mailbox from the mysterious Lorekeeper, requesting your aid. Of course, you’ll need the means to get there. If you’ve yet to discover the Stardust Port, your friend Merlin should be willing to lend a helping hand. 

[h2]A Surprising New Friend…[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42317391/671f6a119f2decee0d748d3fb1ca0660dd79e194.png[/img]

Disembarking from your enchanted transportation, you’ll find yourself in front of a large library; though, it has certainly seen more "happily ever after" days—this first impression reinforced by inky obstructions barring your path in every direction. As you make your way inland, you’ll finally meet up face-to-face with the author of the invitation you received—though, "face" is used a little loosely here. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42317391/b291a1872eb31ca941e8f9ff3810d87481c19474.png[/img]
 
An enchanted book, the Lorekeeper, has acted as a caretaker for these lands—holding them together with the magic found within her pages. While she once safeguarded the stories that inspired the world around her, the discord between the Vale’s ruling villains scattered the stories to the wind in the form of Snippets—magicked origami creatures. The Snippets move in a variety of patterns, so if you want to restore the Lorekeeper’s stories, you’ll need to equip yourself with a new Royal Tool—unfortunately, your Royal Fishing Rod is not equipped for [i]fly[/i]-fishing.
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42317391/4eb6a13663cd378f6d5c6268384e5287d746e99b.png[/img]

With a bit of ingenuity and help from another new friend you’ll meet along the way, you’ll discover the Royal Net close at hand, and then be set to catch all the varieties of Snippets you may encounter. By adding this Tool to your collection, you will also net yourself a new photo mode pose!

[h2]Piecing It All Together[/h2] 

Catching Snippets isn’t the only challenge you’ll be met with from the Lorekeeper’s pages—[i]The Storybook Vale[/i] also introduces a new puzzle mini-game! 
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42317391/78aa7b42f361beaee790afa3c6a0432bef8353b7.png[/img]

Collecting diverse Snippets in all shapes and colors will provide you with the pieces to unlock a variety of puzzles featuring the lore of the Vale, along with illustrations inspired by Disney and Pixar classics. 

As you help the Lorekeeper reclaim her magic, each puzzle you complete will provide you with new decoration options to adorn the walls of your homes and buildings.

[h2]Old and New Friends[/h2]

While the journey ahead may seem jarring, you’ll have plenty of help from old friends... and new! 
With some of them bringing their Valley staples, such as Chez Remy and Goofy’s Stall, your Villagers from both the Valley and Eternity Isle can’t pass up the opportunity to visit! Scrooge McDuck will also provide a new location to capitalize on your adventures get you geared up for the adventures ahead with new clothing and furniture—available only through his Store in the Storybook Vale.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42317391/137197d268f639bec476564d089d39765f68fdb6.png[/img]
 
Speaking of new friends, Part 1 of the [i]Disney Dreamlight Valley: The Storybook Vale[/i] Expansion Pass arrives with its own collection of Villagers who will join you:
[list]
[*] Probably the only Villager to not be enamored by Snippets, Merida from Disney and Pixar’s [i]Brave[/i] joins your quest early on in the Bind—lending her bravery and a helpful hand to kick-start your progress to mend the ruin caused by the seeping ink.
[*] Flynn Rider from Disney’s [i]Tangled[/i] also joins in—lending his quick wit to the aid of your quests, and perhaps some of his less-useful smolder. Of course, we adore a love story! Owners of Disney Dreamlight Valley: A Rift in Time who have bolstered their friendship with Rapunzel will be able to reunite the two through additional quest content.
[*] Perhaps the least-expected addition to your Villagers is Hades—once you’ve chilled his fiery temper. Just keep a cool head and try not to let him make you one of his minions.
[/list]
Additional Villagers arrive for all The Storybook Vale Expansion Pass owners when Part 2 launches in 2025. 

[h2]A World Brimming with Magic[/h2]

Though you may be tempted to curl up with a good book upon landing in the Bind—trust us, there are books everywhere—there’s so much to explore in the [i]Storybook Vale[/i]!

Consisting of three unique Biomes, the vibrant library port of the Bind is only the first area you’ll step foot in. Depending on which path you turn to first, the autumnal, book-filled crevices of the Bind transition to the golden fields of Mythopia or the lush mushroom-filled forest of Everafter. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42317391/e0e43e948c72c0aeb019c4d28e4b3a9a3d0dc597.png[/img]
 
Inspiration from each Biome lends itself to your decorating toolkit—enabling you to make yourself at home with new structures and plants in the Landscaping menu. Foodies can also delight with a treasure trove of new ingredients waiting to be found on land and in the rivers and pools of the Vale. Already full-up and looking for a new pal? Each Biome is also home to a unique critter in different color variations—all waiting to become your next animal companion!
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42317391/45e4d9de6bd05c04eb9564dfe9c6bbff103ee7ad.png[/img]

Flora and fauna aren’t the only things you’ll find in each Biome—grab your Royal Camera and get ready to snap a pic in front of stunning landmarks inspired by your favorite Disney and Pixar stories! You’ll also uncover vast Trials for the adventure-focused… but we’ll leave it to you to uncover all that’s inside them.

[h2]Bonus Rewards for Early Adopters[/h2]

Don’t hesitate to set out for the Vale right away—as a special bonus, early adopters of [i]Disney Dreamlight Valley: The Storybook Vale[/i] who purchase and launch the game before [b]November 30 at 23:59 PM ET[/b] will receive a message in their in-game mailbox containing a stunning collection of dark academia-themed clothing.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42317391/ab5a2e2026e7ca04c856f88da3e69399e9d8e84e.png[/img]
 

Under the guidance of the Lorekeeper, we can’t wait for you to journey to the Vale and meet heroes and villains who will bring epic trials to undertake, stories to reassemble, and friendships to recover.

See you in the Storybook Vale!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3311900/Disney_Dreamlight_Valley_The_Storybook_Vale__Magical_Edition/

notes.title: The Storybook Vale - Part 1 Patch Notes
notes.content:
Hey Valley Villagers!

This week, we turn the page to a new chapter for Disney Dreamlight Valley as we celebrate the release of a new paid expansion pass, Disney Dreamlight Valley: The Storybook Vale - Part 1. Travel to a new world and capture treasured tales to unveil beloved Disney and Pixar stories! Meet heroes and villains who have epic trials to undertake, stories to reassemble, and friendships to recover. Master a new Royal Tool and collect all manner of new rewards to further express your creativity and style! All this and more awaits you in the Vale.

Not only that, but this update also includes a range of bug fixes that impact all owners of Disney Dreamlight Valley. These fixes pave the way for our next free update – “Sew Delightful” – which will release on December 4, 2024. Stay tuned for more details about this update in the coming week!
But returning our focus to this week, Disney Dreamlight Valley: The Storybook Vale - Part 1 arrives on November 20, 2024! Check out all the details of this update below:

[h2]NEW CONTENT (THE STORYBOOK VALE EXPANSION PASS OWNERS):[/h2]
[list]
[*] A new land to explore! Step into Storybook Vale and discover a land made up of myths and fairytales come to life, comprised of 3 stunning and expansive new biomes: the Bind, Everafter, and Mythopia.
[*] A new questline! Meet the Lorekeeper and puzzle through the motivations of two competing rulers in this epic new tale, filled with new friends and new quests.
[*] 3 new characters! As you adventure through the Vale, join forces with Merida from Disney and Pixar’s Brave, Flynn Rider from Disney’s Tangled, and Hades from Disney’s Hercules, unlocking new Friendship Quests and new unique items along the way.
[*] New Royal Tool! Harness the power of the Royal Net to capture Snippets – living embodiments of the Lorekeeper’s scattered pages –and piece together the story of the Vale. Show off this tool with a new Photo Mode pose, as well.
[*] New puzzle and quest types! Complete beautiful tapestries that tell the stories behind classic Disney and Pixar films and delve into Trials – new quests inspired by fairytales and myths – which are sure to put your adventuring skills to the test.
[*] New animal companions! Discover new critters to befriend, as well as their many variations, in each of the Vale’s new biomes.
[*] New shipment alert! Browse a new batch of goods in Scrooge McDuck’s Store, available for owners of the expansion pass!
[*] New renos! Scrooge McDuck’s Store and Chez Remy each receive a visual refresh to match their surroundings in the Bind.
[*] New decorations, clothing and collectibles! Collect all manner of new items to express your creativity in these new surroundings and unlock a wide range of new crafting and cooking recipes.
[/list]

[h2]NEW CONTENT AND IMPROVEMENTS (AVAILABLE TO ALL PLAYERS):[/h2]
[list]
[*] Each instance of Scrooge McDuck’s Store (The Valley, Eternity Isle, Storybook Vale) will now offer a separate rotation of goods to check in on each day. Please note: The item rotations offered in the Valley and Eternity Isle draw from the same base game item pool you know and love.
[*] New Photo Mode pose! Show off your glider of choice with a new Photo Mode pose.
[/list]

[h2]TOP CHANGES AND BUG FIXES (AVAILABLE TO ALL PLAYERS):[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue in which Nintendo Switch players could not share photos via QR code.
[*] Fixed additional instances in which players may encounter “Initialization Error #6”.
[*] Fixed an issue in which incorrect amount of night thorns would spawn in the Valley.
[*] Fixed an issue in which fishing ripples would not spawn in the Sunlit Plateau biome.
[*] Fixed issues which would prevent some PlayStation trophies from unlocking.
[*] Fixed an issue in which some items would not show up in the Collection.
[*] “Fishing for Precision” quest: Fixed an issue in which salmon could now be transferred to the cauldron.
[*] “A New Directive” quest: Fixed an issue in which the BnL Blanket would not spawn.
[*] Fixed an issue in which taking a picture while gathering villagers with an interactable furniture item would not progress certain quests.
[*] Fixed an issue in which players would be guided to Chez Remy when selecting a villager dining in Tiana’s Palace.
[*] Fixed an issue in which Moana’s Fishing Boat would display the wrong quantity of each fish type caught.
[*] Fixed an issue in which villager speech bubbles would occasionally move around the screen when moving the camera.
[*] Fixed an issue in which there would be a delay when closing the “House Floors” menu.
[*] Fixed an issue in which players would spawn outside of the game world after leaving a Scramblecoin match.
[*] Fixed an issue in which placed segments of the Wrought Iron Fence would not follow a consistent pattern.
[*] Fixed an issue in which Time Rifts would not display an animation when transitioning between visual states.
[*] Fixed an issue in which certain furniture in Mulan’s house would display incorrectly if the camera was moved outside of the room.
[*] Fixed an issue in which the selection highlight in the Premium Shop would disappear.
[*] Fixed an issue in which the camera could be moved out of bounds when placing paths.
[*] “The M.U.S.H.U. Program” quest: Fixed an issue in which the items necessary to progress in this quest would be unbreakable.
[*] Fixed an issue in which certain motifs would display a visual glitch when placed.
[*] Fixed an issue in which exiting Jafar’s Palace would return the player to the entrance they initially entered from, rather than the correct exit location.

[*] Fixed clipping issues present on various clothing items.

notes.title: Catch up on the Disney Dreamlight Valley 2024 Showcase Stream!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42317391/e250c0c25b9dc998e292398a7f0e8ea10a5ca5b3.png[/img]
[h3]Hey Valley Villagers![/h3]

With thrilling updates to the base game and an expansion pass that transports us to the brand new Storybook Vale, today’s Disney Dreamlight Valley Showcase Stream provided a sneak peek at what lies ahead for the Valley and beyond!

If you haven’t seen it yet, or just want to catch it again, check out the full Showcase Stream below and join us as we dive into all the exciting announcements. 

[previewyoutube=NJJ6OqlJig0;full][/previewyoutube]

[h1]Celebrate Sally’s arrival on December 4th[/h1]

As many players guessed from [url=https://x.com/DisneyDLV/status/1821216032775704749/photo/1]our last roadmap reveal[/url] – Sally from Disney Tim Burton’s The Nightmare Before Christmas joins as the latest Villager in our next free update, “Sew Delightful”! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42317391/efceed9f0afb33defdaa2acd303c59c4b3ea8e2a.png[/img]

Bringing her signature patchwork style to the Valley, she arrives not only with exciting friendship rewards, but a thrilling set of quests that include a date night, quilting, and more!

[h1]The sky’s the limit with New Features[/h1]

Expand the limits of your decorating with much-requested features also arriving in our next free update! Teased earlier this year in our [url=https://disneydreamlightvalley.com/news/ValleyVignette]Valley Vignette[/url], push the boundaries of your creativity with the introduction of Floating Islands – large areas accessible through the Fast Travel menu once they’ve been unlocked with Dreamlight. Inclusive of their own decoration limits, use these blank canvases themed after each of the existing Valley biomes to design new areas to house your favorite building, Villagers, and furniture items!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42317391/0e85a73611f0437afbf356acccfe88a67da0e2ef.png[/img]
 
We’re sure today’s other décor-related reveal has left you spinning – 16-degree rotation is coming to 
the Valley! Enjoy rotating not only your furniture, but buildings, landscaping items and more when this feature arrives on December 4th.

[h1]A new chapter unfurls in our next Expansion Pass[/h1]

Launching on November 20th, part one of our next paid expansion, Disney Dreamlight Valley: The Storybook Vale, invites you to make use of your Stardust Port once again!

[previewyoutube=Tv3kFpaq4Co;full][/previewyoutube]

Be whisked away to the Vale and embark on an enchanting adventure with a cast of new characters including the Lorekeeper – a magical book holding this fantastical land together. However, a happily ever after is a ways off as you discover that discordance between two iconic Disney Villains - Maleficent from Disney’s Sleeping Beauty and Hades from Disney’s Hercules, has torn this land apart. 

Causing mysterious phenomenon across The Vale’s three biomes – the Bind, Everafter, and Mythopia – their conflict has yielded Ink seeping out of the very ground and sent the pages of the Lorekeeper near and far as enchanted page pieces called Snippets. 
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42317391/39ad7b467e69be6101708fec4ef0682650629eaa.png[/img]

As you uncover its mysteries, part one of the Disney Dreamlight Valley: The Storybook Vale expansion pass will lead you to encounter the courageous Merida from Disney and Pixar’s Brave, the bold Flynn Rider from Disney’s Tangled, and the fiery Hades. Two additional characters will arrive in part two of the expansion pass when it releases later in 2025.

New friends aren’t the only thing you’re adding to your mystery-solving toolkit. You’ll also gain the advantage of a new tool – the Royal Net – that will enable you to capture the various Snippets that have escaped the Lorekeeper’s pages. 
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42317391/4eb6a13663cd378f6d5c6268384e5287d746e99b.png[/img]

There’s a lot more to be excited about, so stay tuned for more and check out the expansion roadmap below:
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42317391/e19a61d06998c1f326e5b8720de371e72b7dc421.png[/img]

[h1]See what the future holds in the updated Content Roadmap[/h1]

While the end of the year holds so much to explore, we wanted to share the spotlight with additional content arriving next year in our updated free content roadmap. Check it out below:
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42317391/f6005688535d65c9c90e456a0ec6448e58c673bb.png[/img]

[h1]New Editions and Early Adopter Bonuses[/h1]

Looking to dive right into the new content that awaits you in the Vale   on day one? Disney Dreamlight Valley: The Storybook Vale will be available as an additional purchase for owners of the base game of Disney Dreamlight Valley or as a part of The Magical Edition which includes bonus Moonstones, a collection of librarian-chic cosmetic items and a truly adorable Baby Pegasus animal companion!  Disney Dreamlight Valley Arcade Edition owners will have access to the contents of The Storybook Vale expansion pass day one without the need for additional purchase. 
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42317391/01063b9ca60fb9e88207a806b9fab4c7ea981846.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42317391/686c74cf86619216b7d4853fafc73b6c1e3b3a2e.png[/img]

If you’re new to Disney Dreamlight Valley, this is as great a starting point as any! Between the Disney Dreamlight Valley Base Game, the Storybook Vale Bundle, and the Enchanted Edition, you’ll be able to choose the content that’s right for you. 

Additionally, anyone who purchases and launches Disney Dreamlight Valley: The Storybook Vale before December 2024 will receive a message in their in-game mailbox containing a stunning collection of dark academia-themed clothing. 
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42317391/ff89e52041f33b2d51da474fa55d40a0200e0cd8.png[/img]

[hr][/hr]

We can’t wait for you to experience all that the Vale holds when part one of the Disney Dreamlight Valley: The Storybook Vale launches on November 20th, and for you to welcome Sally to your Valleys in our free content update, “Sew Delightful”, on December 4th. Thank you for taking part in this magical journey with us!

See you in the Valley, and in the Vale very soon!

notes.title: Discover the Jungle Getaway Update!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42317391/60e6a8a14168744b216859133e4aabbf2e56be73.png[/img]

Hey, Valley Villagers!

We're returning to Disney's [i]The Lion King[/i] Realm in our latest free update to welcome two NEW friends! Now live on all platforms, embark on a "Jungle Getaway" to discover the art of relaxation with a laid-back duo and rock out with thrilling rewards in the latest Star Path—The Night Show!

Plenty of other surprises await, from a limited-time collaboration to many top-requested features and quality-of-life updates. Read on to learn more!

[previewyoutube=By2Ghdlw7PY;full][/previewyoutube]

[h1]Return to The Lion King Realm in the Light of Day![/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42317391/fd9d473b445cdb6f30cfa133ce112b2dfbdd77c5.png[/img]

First revealed in our [url=https://disneydreamlightvalley.com/news/ValleyVignette]Valley Vignette blog[/url] from earlier this year, two new Villagers arrive in this update—Timon and Pumbaa from [i]The Lion King[/i]!

As you return to their Realm, it seems like the stress of saving the Valley time and time again has taken its toll—with Timon declaring that you must learn the ways of hakuna matata! Of course, learning the art of relaxation isn't a one-step process, and you'll need to experience a few days and nights in the Realm. (Don't worry; time passes differently within!)

After you're sufficiently relaxed and have given your easygoing pals a hand with a sticky situation, they'll arrive in your Valley—bringing with them unique Quests, Friendship rewards, and aromas…? Continue the fun by helping them feel at home—which involves sorting out a "stinky" situation with Pumbaa and aiding Timon in cataloging the Valley's critters.

[h1]Get Ready to ROCK with a New Star Path![/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42317391/dbc9991b963df87e9bbde6db6847e0a0cbaccd7c.png[/img]

Neon lights and pyrotechnic delights await you in this season's Star Path—The Night Show!

We're challenging you to build the stage of your dreams with furniture items featuring unique special effects such as neon, changing lights, fire, and more! Then, amp up your Avatar with rebellious clothing inspired by Disney Villains, Disney Princess characters, and of course, rock music.

This Star Path features a reduced number of rewards (reflected in a discounted Premium-tier cost and number of duties) as we build up to more content releases later this year—but don't let that fool you! It's full of rock-star-realness and high-quality collectibles! Make sure to complete it before it ends on November 27.

[h1]A Surprise Collaboration and More![/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42317391/80be797b6dfba73ada17ddcdc2ab5d0e62003589.png[/img]

[b]Loungefly backpacks are available now in the Valley![/b] We're thrilled to share that we've collaborated with Loungefly, bringing multiple recreations of their statement-making backpacks to the Valley. Styles that you may already have in your personal collection can either be found in-game by completing The Night Show Star Path, as well as in the Premium Shop for a limited time. You can also redeem the code [b]DDV2024OOOOO[/b]† in-game by November 20 at 9 am ET / 2 pm UTC to claim a Mickey BOO! Loungefly Backpack for your Avatar!

And don't forget to share a screenshot or fan art of your Avatar wearing one of the in-game Loungefly collaboration items for a chance to win one of six physical Halloween-themed bags in our Haunted Holiday Sweepstakes! Full sweepstakes details and rules here: https://gleam.io/1LFHa/haunted-holiday-sweepstakes

[b]Scrooge McDuck gets new stock![/b] Make sure to stop by Scrooge McDuck's Store for a chance to purchase additional furniture from Realms and Villager homes as they appear in daily stock rotations.

[b]Premium Shop updates![/b] New content arrives in weekly rotations, along with a recommendation system to help you collect items you may have missed.

In addition to the exciting new content coming to the Premium Shop this update, we are also adding a new Moonstone-pack option to the Moonstone menu in the Premium Shop. This pack will include both Moonstones and a seasonal Valley-inspired cosmetic item. It will be available for a limited time, and different seasonal Valley-inspired cosmetic items may be offered with future updates.

[i]† Redemption code features both zeroes and the letter O: DDV20[One "ZERO"]24OOOOO[Five "LETTER O"].[/i]

[h1]Frightfully Delicious Treats Await![/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42317391/7ad71a73a90b7e78fba1a57b1e71514363c6205e.png[/img]

The Trick-or-Treat event returns! From October 23 to 31, collect Candy Bowls that appear in the Plaza to gather green, purple, and red Candies. These sweets can be consumed or gifted to complete Event Duties—granting you seasonal rewards!

This year's event also brings with it a new craftable furniture item: Turn your event treats into Mickey's Halloween Candy Bowl! A crafting recipe will arrive in your in-game mailbox once the event starts.

[b]Need the perfect Halloween costume? We've got you covered![/b] All players can look forward to claiming an Evil Queen Costume FOR FREE from the Premium Shop as part of our seasonal festivities closer to Halloween. Keep an eye out on our social media and in-game for more news on its arrival!

[h1]Community-Driven Features[/h1]

We want to extend a huge thanks to everyone who continues to participate in sharing their feedback on each and every update. Here are just a few of the highlights arriving in Jungle Getaway, inspired by players like you!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42317391/f7c04757aedbd576f2bf08c722cc92b30dae4611.png[/img]

[b]Customize the way you play![/b] Arriving in this update are three additional options in the Settings menu in the Gameplay and Controls tabs. If you use a controller, check out the "New Edit Mode Controls" option to swap between editing playstyles, featuring a locked or free cursor.

The new "Use Alternative Sprint Button" allows you to use the newer Sprint button option that was introduced in our Dapper Delights update—or revert to the previous button option. Lastly, enabling the "Tap to Sprint" option will allow you to sprint by tapping your preferred sprint button option versus holding it.

[b]Take to the air with new glider options![/b] Get more use out of your favorite wing back accessories with a new glider option! All wings currently available in-game will be able to be worn as a glider accessory, replacing the "surfing" glider animation with a fluttering animation more befitting wings.

[b]Never forget the task at hand[/b] with new tracking options for duties and crafting recipes, allowing them to appear instead of a Quest in the upper left portion of the screen.

[b]Your Royal Tools become more useful[/b] with a new Photo Mode option, allowing your Avatar to hold a Royal Tool while snapping a pic! You'll be able to feature other handheld accessories as well, when equipped.

We can't wait to see how you enjoy diving into the Jungle Getaway update! Make sure to connect with us on our official social media accounts below and tag us in your in-game photos!

[list]
[*] [b]Instagram[/b]:[url= https://gmlft.co/DDV-Instagram] https://gmlft.co/DDV-Instagram[/url]

[*] [b]TikTok[/b]: [url=https://gmlft.co/DDV-TikTok]https://gmlft.co/DDV-TikTok[/url]
[/list]

As always, should you run into any issues while playing [i]Disney Dreamlight Valley[/i], we first recommend that you check out our known issues [url=https://trello.com/b/WY5gDde3/disney-dreamlight-valley-issue-tracker-board]here[/url]. If you don't see the issue you're running into, you can get in touch with our Support team via [url=https://gameloft.helpshift.com/hc/en/66-disney-dreamlight-valley/]our contact form[/url]. Stumped by a certain Quest or objective? Check out our friendly [url=https://discord.com/invite/disneydreamlightvalley]Discord Community[/url] for some [i]Disney Dreamlight Valley[/i] tips and tricks!

See you in the Valley!

notes.title: Jungle Getaway Update Patch Notes
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42317391/4b3f7d41e5e9df52f5fabeb095e08580b86a8b52.png[/img]

Hey Valley Villagers!

We hope you enjoyed the recent [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=rK7qi44pC8s]Developer Update[/url] video! With our next content update releasing a little later this week, it’s about time to dig into patch notes.

Not only will we be returning to a familiar Realm for a new adventure in a new light, but we've also got a stunning collaboration coming to the game and a bunch of quality-of-life improvements that draw upon all-important player feedback.

[i]Disney Dreamlight Valley’s[/i] “Jungle Getaway” Update arrives on October 9, 2024, so check out all the details below:

[h1]NEW CONTENT (AVAILABLE TO ALL PLAYERS*):[/h1]

[list]
[*] Return to Disney’s [i]The Lion King[/i] Realm and experience the Realm in a new light with a day and night cycle, new quests, and new friends. Speaking of...  
[*] Two new characters! Embrace equal parts relaxation and antics as Timon and Pumbaa from Disney’s [i]The Lion King[/i] arrive in the Valley, alongside new Friendship Quests and unique new items.
[*] A new Star Path! Turn your Valley into a music festival with The Night Show Star Path, featuring furniture that’ll literally help you set the stage, a Rockstar Turtle animal companion, as well as clothing inspired by Disney Villains, Disney Princess, and rock music.
[*] Dress to impress! Dig into an exciting collaboration with Loungefly, in which recreations of Loungefly’s statement-making backpacks will arrive in the game across the Star Path, Premium Shop and social media. Keep an eye out for more details in the launch day blog!
[*] Prepare your pumpkins! The Trick or Treat in-game event returns to the Valley from October 23 to 31, featuring a brand new reward!
[*] Weekly rotations to look forward to! Keep an eye out for new optional items in the Premium Shop (alongside some returning favorites), as well as new, weekly DreamSnaps challenges and rewards.
[*] New shipment alert! Scrooge McDuck’s Store has received a new batch of goods for sale, including additional Realm decor!
[*] Adjusted available Moonstone packs to introduce a new option that includes both Moonstones and a seasonal Valley inspired cosmetic item. This pack will be offered for a limited time and different seasonal cosmetic items may be offered with future updates.
[/list]

* Please note: [i]Disney Dreamlight Valley Arcade Edition[/i] does not include seasonal Star Paths or the Premium Shop.

[h1]IMPROVEMENTS (AVAILABLE TO ALL PLAYERS):[/h1]

[h2]CONTROLS:[/h2]

[list]
[*] Added a toggle to the Settings > Controls menu to select between two different camera control methods when using a gamepad in Edit Mode. Players will be able to select between an option that’s akin to the game’s original, free-flowing control style, or a new hybrid approach that locks the cursor to the center of the screen, while also giving the ability to move it freely by holding a button.
[*] [i]Please note: This control methods selection will apply to outdoor areas. Edit Mode while in the Player House will default to the original control style.[/i]
[*] Added a toggle to the Settings > Controls menu to select between two different sprinting control methods when using a gamepad, allowing players to revert to the previous button mapping or use the updated button mapping (Left Bumper) introduced last update.
[*] Added a toggle to the Settings > Gameplay menu to enable a “Tap to Sprint” control option, allowing players to start and stop sprinting at the press of a button without needing to hold it.
[*] Added full support for wireless controllers on Steam without requiring Steam Input to be enabled. If you have not previously adjusted this option, the game will now default to "Built-In" support (our recommendation) and can be adjusted as needed in the Settings > Controls menu.
[/list]

[h2]SCROOGE MCDUCK’S STORE:[/h2]

[list]
[*] Scrooge’s McDuck’s Store will now display furniture items in place of empty clothing mannequins, including in the window displays.
[/list]

[h2]DREAMSNAPS & PHOTO MODE:[/h2]

[list]
[*] Added a “skip” button to the DreamSnaps voting screen, allowing players to skip up to 10 votes per day.
[*] Added the ability for avatars to hold hand accessories (i.e. umbrellas) and Royal Tools while in Photo Mode.
[/list]

[h2]PREMIUM SHOP:[/h2]

[list]
[*] Added a new “Recommended” section to the Premium Shop, which will feature four additional items or bundles each week. The contents of this section will differ from player to player, based on their Premium Shop interests.
[/list]


[h2]OTHER:[/h2]

[list]
[*] Added the ability to equip wearable wings as a Glider in the Wardrobe. All wings currently available in the game will be equipable this way, replacing the “surfing” Glider animation with a fluttering animation more befitting of wings.
[*] Added the ability to track your progress on individual Dreamlight Duties and Star Path Duties, as well as the collection of materials for crafting recipes via the on-screen Quest Tracker.
[*] Various UI improvements were made to the Star Path menu.
[/list]

[h1]TOP CHANGES AND BUG FIXES:[/h1]

[list]
[*] Fixed additional instances in which players may encounter “Initialization Error #6”.
[*] “Bibbidi-Bobbidi-Oops” quest: Fixed an issue in which Olaf's parasol would not appear on the beach.
[*] “The Secrets of Eternity Isle” quest: Fixed an issue in which some players couldn't access the gate to Eternity Isle.
[*] “The Ancient Door” quest: Fixed an issue in which the game wouldn’t recognize that the Gray Floating Rocks had been removed.
[*] “The Spark of Imagination” quest: Fixed an issue in which the player would get stuck between quest steps.
[*] “Diamond in the Rough” quest: Fixed an issue in which some Apple Arcade players were not able to pick up the Jewel of Time.
[*] “The M.U.S.H.U. Program” quest: Fixed an issue in which some players would be unable to progress past the "Destroy some old furniture near Beast’s house" step of the quest.
[*] “The M.U.S.H.U. Program” quest: Fixed an issue in which "The Beast's Old Attire" could be found and collected in Disney’s [i]The Beauty and the Beast[/i] Realm before accepting the relevant quest.
[*] “Back From the Bayou” quest: Fixed an issue in which placing the inauguration ribbon in the wrong spot would result in it becoming immovable.
[*] “Jafar’s Laboratory” quest: Fixed an issue in which the hourglass would not spin.
[*] “Scrapbook Blitz” quest: Fixed an issue in which Goofy's Dreamlight Valley Scrapbook could not be placed.
[*] Fixed various issues which could, in rare cases, cause a game crash when loading on PlayStation consoles.
[*] Fixed an issue in which it was possible for a room within the player’s house to have no doors.
[*] Fixed an issue in which certain gamepads would not respond during wireless connection.
[*] Fixed various instances in which players could get stuck on invisible walls.
[*] Fixed an issue in which the “similar Items” filter would open when trying to navigate with the D-pad.
[*] Fixed an issue in which pork would not appear for purchase at Gaston’s stall.
[*] Fixed an issue in which plants could grow under certain gazebo furniture items.
[*] Fixed an issue in which the Halloween filter would not work properly in the Delivery menu and Furniture Catalog in Scrooge McDuck’s Store.
[*] Fixed an issue in which part of the wall would disappear when interacting with the Timebending Table in the Secluded Beach of Eternity Isle.
[*] Fixed an issue in which certain meals required for Remy’s Special Deliveries would appear with a quest marker on it after having cooked the meal.
[*] Fixed an issue in which the crafting animation could be skipped.
[*] Fixed various audio and visual issues involving cutscenes in the Disney’s [i]Mulan[/i] Realm.
[*] Fixed an issue in which the environment around the player could become blurry during a Valley Visit after the hosting player enters or exits a building.
[*] Fixed an issue in which Jafar is partially off-screen on the Friendship level-up screen.
[*] Fixed an issue in which the Search Filter on the Furniture and Wardrobe menus could not be highlighted after attempting to navigate to it from the bottom of the menu.
[*] Fixed various visual bugs within Edit Mode, as well as Premium Shop and Scrooge McDuck’s Store item previews.
[*] Fixed clipping issues present on various clothing items.
[*] Fixed an issue in which the lighting in Tiana's Palace would appear too dark.
[*] Fixed an issue in which Wallpapers and Flooring items would not be shown in the Favorites/Hidden categories.
[*] Fixed an issue in which the fishing minigame would not end after releasing the button when the "Hold to Complete Fishing" setting was On.
[*] Fixed an issue in Scramblecoin, in which the collected coin amount may not be shown or may be shown in the wrong place.
[*] Fixed an issue in which moving Eternity Isle’s default chest to the player’s inventory while it still had items in it would trigger an error message.
[*] Various additional bug fixes relating to audio, visual, localization, gamepad control, and user interface issues, in addition to stability improvements.
[/list]

Want to stay up to date on all things [i]Disney Dreamlight Valley[/i]? Sign up for newsletter updates [url=https://disneydreamlightvalley.com/]here[/url], bookmark our [url=https://gmlft.co/DDV-Trello]Trello Issue Tracker[/url], and be sure to follow us on our social media channels:

notes.title: End of Summer Event
notes.content:
Hey Valley Villagers!

We’re thrilled to see how you’ve been diving into the recently released “Dapper Delights” and “Treasures of Time” content – and we’ve got another surprise content drop arriving in-game soon!
[previewyoutube=ZF81_kvYYOg;full][/previewyoutube]
[h2]End of Summer Event[/h2]
Showcased in today’s [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=tmcgU1_f0Zc]Nintendo Direct[/url], gear up to celebrate the end of the season with the new ‘End of Summer’ event arriving in Disney Dreamlight Valley.

Running from September 4th - 26th, grab your binoculars and begin your search for specialty Marshmallows in-game! To fuel your hunt, you’ll also receive two new recipes for campfire-inspired delicacies, but you’ll need to gather the ingredients first.

While you’ll find 3 bushes in your Valley Plaza sporting pink marshmallows, you’ll need to stay alert for blue marshmallows appearing in the Plaza, Peaceful Meadow, Dazzle Beach, Forest of Valor, and Glade of Trust. Once you’ve collected a few – head over to your favorite cooking spot to create some tasty treats like S’mores to share with your friends and Valley Villagers.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42317391/8ca692ff50d3b77587e69274d408193f97299a16.png[/img]
These fluffy and sweet snacks aren’t just used for cooking, however! You’ll find brand new crafting recipes available to turn your marshmallows into campsite essentials, like a Bonfire Pit! This item, once placed, will allow you interact with it to take photos with your nearby Villagers – the perfect way to make an end of summer memory.
And, don’t forget to complete 2 new duties in-game by gifting and eating marshmallow-based dishes – granting you new wearables for your Avatar.

[hr][/hr]

Take your End of Summer event celebrations a step further by connecting with us on our official social media accounts below to tag us in your in-game photos and other content!

Instagram: [url=https://gmlft.co/DDV-Instagram]https://gmlft.co/DDV-Instagram[/url]

notes.title: August 28 Hotfix Patch Notes
notes.content:
Hey Valley Villagers!

Happy hotfix day! Following up on our recent [url=https://disneydreamlightvalley.com/news/DapperDelightsUpdate]“Dapper Delights” update[/url], we’ve been hard at work monitoring your feedback. We're excited to share an update with everyone today that addresses many of the top bugs and issues we’ve seen our community members reporting.

Thank you to everyone who has shared their feedback with us thus far! Your input not only helps us prioritize critical issues but also helps us in identifying where gameplay features can be further enhanced.

Please find the details of the contents of the hotfix below:

[h1]BUG FIXES AND OTHER IMPROVEMENTS:[/h1]

[list]
[*] Resolved an issue where players were unable to enter their player home or additional homes using the Winter Palace House Style.
[*] A mannequin will no longer spawn in some building interiors after players have created an outfit preset.
[*] Dragon Candy will no longer appear as a Favorite Gift.
[*] Resolved an issue where 5 mails (“It's so good to be back”, “Your Royal Tool Set gets a new look!” (x2), “A culinary development”, “An Apology”) without claimable content would appear with a reward icon and remain in the Unread section of the Mailbox.
[*] The Lady's House Dream Style can now be applied to Player House.
[*] Players who have progressed Jafar’s friendship level past 7 will now be able to take on his level 7 friendship quest, “The Serpent’s Gift”.
[*] Resolved an issue where players could not place pathing and fencing near buildings.
[*] The Dazzle Beach Light Dwarf Birch and Forest of Valor Tree Trunk are now accessible through the Landscaping menu without the need to use the DreamSnaps filter.
[*] Resolved an issue where the Skeletal Royal Hourglass style was not granted to players who had previously purchased the tool set from the Premium Shop.
[*] Resolved an issue where the new Reset Room feature would block quest progress if used when first visiting the Player Home at the start of a new game.
[*] Players completing the Mulan Realm "Protecting the Camp" quest will be able to locate the correct amount of planting spots.
[*] The quest counter will now accurately measure the amount of fencing placed in the Tiana "Little Louis' Break" quest
[*] Additional fixes for players experiencing Error Initialization #6.
[*] The stove on the Dapper Delights Star Path banner has been replaced, as the item is instead rewarded by leveling friendship with Tiana.
[*] Resolved an issue where Rapunzel was unable to cross the bridge necessary in a "Use Your Imagination" quest step.
[*] Resolved an issue where players were unable to pick up the Memory in the "A Taste for Literature" quest.
[*] Resolved collision issues with the Shadow Theater furniture item.
[*] Resolved an issue where the DreamSnaps Filter would display an incorrect challenge name.
[*] Resolved an issue where the Jafar Figurine appeared in Scrooge McDuck’s Store. It will now be granted to players who obtain the Jafar Scramblecoin Figurine as intended.
[/list]

notes.title: Discover the Dapper Delights Update and Expansion Pass Act III!
notes.content:
Hey Valley Villagers!

Get ready for double the fun, and twice the excitement with two content releases today – our twelfth free update, “Dapper Delights”, and “Treasures of Time” – Act III of the [i]Disney Dreamlight Valley: A Rift in Time[/i] expansion pass – available to all expansion pass owners.

This begs the question: will you start your next adventure in the Valley, or on Eternity Isle? Whichever you choose – you’re in for a treat! Each content update brings with it a new Villager, thrilling furniture, and dazzling cosmetic items for your Avatar. Our “Dapper Delights” Star Path also begins today – injecting your time spent in the Valley with even more content to complete and rewards to discover!

[hr][/hr]
[h1]Dapper Delights abound in our latest update![/h1]
[previewyoutube=rDbp8LcbBJc;full][/previewyoutube]
[h2]Tantalize your taste buds at Tiana’s Palace![/h2]
Originally announced in our [url=https://www.youtube.com/live/DTfzE_f3FUE]2023 Showcase Stream[/url], Tiana finally makes her way to [i]Disney Dreamlight Valley[/i]! But, before you can get cooking, you’ll need to do some questing in the Glade of Trust first…

There, you’ll find a mysterious cookbook – something you should ask the Valley’s ‘littlest chef’ about! Through the magic of cooking, sharing memories, and of course, a little bit of Dreamlight, Tiana will join your Valley – bringing with her not only new quests and friendship rewards, but her restaurant, Tiana’s Palace, alongside plenty of flavorful recipes for you to cook up and share with your Villagers!

 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42317391/26e98a7de9d5a8c8da478bd4bb4c8ef065e89940.png[/img]

Of course – that’s not arriving with the Valley’s latest Disney Princess! Tiana is dabbling in takeout dining and will sell a selection of pre-made meals at her Meal Stall – the perfect place to chow down for any Valley Hero on the go. 

[h2]Be the Bee’s Knees with new Star Path fashions![/h2]
Bring the roaring twenties style n' swing to your Valley with the ‘Dapper Delights’ Star Path! Expect to cook up fanciful meals and spend time with Tiana to complete new duties to claim ‘Lily pad Tokens’ that can be redeemed for flapper-fashions, art nouveau furniture – and even a dapper look for Donald Duck. 

Scrooge McDuck’s Store also receives new stock with the addition of some clothing items and furniture arriving from Realms – and even the Store’s furnishings themselves!

[h2]Revel in regal-realness with a new bundle![/h2]
 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42317391/c6e095f1b18582260887b21c35a9a6bd76682697.png[/img]

Just in time for World Princess Week (Aug 25th-31st) – add some seaside splendor to your Valley with a new Premium Shop Bundle! You’re cordially invited to tap into your inner Disney Prince or Princess with exclusive royal fashions and hairstyles - Ariel also joins in on the dress up fun with a Dream Style inspired by her classic pink gown from Disney’s [i]The Little Mermaid[/i]. 

Your Player Home also gets the royal treatment with a new House Dream Style along with interior and exterior furniture items – all set for you to decorate and transform your Valley or player home into a little piece of Atlantica.

[h2]Bridging your Valleys with cross-play – and other Community-Driven features![/h2]
We’re thrilled to enhance your [i]Disney Dreamlight Valley[/i] play sessions with a bounty of new features and improvements, inspired by feedback and suggestions from our Community! Thank you to everyone who continues to participate in sharing their thoughts with us on our social media posts or surveys. Here are just a few of the highlights arriving in this update, as requested by players like you!

[h3]PlayStation cross-play is HERE! *†[/h3] All players, regardless of platform, can now participate in multiplayer play! We can’t wait to see your selfies from your shared Valley Visit adventures.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42317391/34546de3909ae358b642d77d5a8c6965e7fcdb4c.png[/img]

[h3]Wardrobe and Furniture Mode Improvements galore![/h3] In addition to the much-requested search bar, you can now mark items in your Furniture and Wardrobe menus as favorites; pushing items to the top, or hide those you aren’t currently vibing with. 

[h3]Save your faves! Outfit presets are HERE![/h3] Save up to four outfits and name them in the Wardrobe Menu, enabling you to quickly swap between you favorite ‘fits.

[h3]Upgrade your patio with updates to Remy’s Special Deliveries![/h3] We loved seeing everyone engaging with this new feature – based off of your feedback, deliveries will now reward additional Wrought Iron, and we’ve lowered the amounts of materials required to craft certain tables and chairs. 

… and that’s not all! Be sure to check out [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1401590]our full Patch Notes here[/url] for even more features and improvements arriving in Dapper Delights!

[i]* While Disney Dreamlight Valley now supports cross-play between all platforms, cross-save between PlayStation and other platforms is not available currently.
† Multiplayer requires an internet connection, and may require an active subscription to online services, depending on what platform you use. [url=https://gameloft.helpshift.com/hc/en/66-disney-dreamlight-valley/faq/3561-do-i-need-to-subscribe-to-xbox-game-pass-playstationplus-or-nintendo-switch-online-to-use-the-multiplayer-feature/]See here for more information[/url].[/i]

[hr][/hr]
[h1]Experience the Final Act of Disney Dreamlight Valley: A Rift in Time![/h1]

It’s time to return to Eternity Isle as the story continues, and concludes, in the [i]Disney Dreamlight Valley: A Rift in Time[/i] expansion pass! The clock is ticking in Act III – “Treasures of Time” – and it’s going to take plenty of ingenuity and imagination to foil Jafar’s plans for good.

If you’re just joining us on your Eternity Isle adventures, or you need a recap – we’ve got you covered. The [i]Disney Dreamlight Valley: A Rift in Time[/i] expansion pass opens a whole new world to play in filled with brand new quests, Villagers, features, and even a new tool – the Royal Hourglass. All set in a mysterious, time-forgotten land, its epic journey rolls out in three acts – the final act arriving TODAY!

[h2]Treasures of Time[/h2]
Our story left off with a Jafar stealing the Spark of Imagination – causing the sky to break… again. The appearance of these sky rifts not only threatens Eternity Isle, but your Villagers, as well... 
[previewyoutube=ehja3MNuWoo;full][/previewyoutube]

It’ll be a race against time to turn back the effects of Jafar’s schemes – but you won’t be alone. Your Eternity Isle companions will aid you with their own imaginative ideas, helping you to finally enter Jafar’s Palace. With plenty of puzzles and surprises inside, it’s up to you to uncover the rest of the story – and a fitting end to all of Jafar’s machinations. 

[h2]A surprising new friend…[/h2]
Of course, [i]Disney Dreamlight Valley[/i] is a home to heroes and villains alike, and it won’t be long until the help of a certain royal vizier is needed. After the events of “Treasures of Time”, Jafar joins your Valley as a companion with his own friendship quests, rewards, and charismatic charms.

Scramblecoin enthusiasts also add more magic to their boards with a new Jafar figurine – his tendency towards the unpredictable eking through with a playstyle that changes every turn it’s on the board.

[hr][/hr]

We’re so excited to see you explore and experience all that our “Dapper Delights” Update and Act III of the [i]Disney Dreamlight Valley: A Rift in Time[/i] expansion pass have to offer! Make sure to connect with us on our official social media accounts below and tag us in your in-game photos!
[list]
[*] [url=https://gmlft.co/DDV-Instagram]Instagram[/url]
[*] [url=https://gmlft.co/DDV-X]X[/url]
[*] [url=https://gmlft.co/DDV-Facebook]Facebook[/url]
[*] [url=https://gmlft.co/DDV-YouTube]YouTube[/url]
[*] [url=https://gmlft.co/DDV-TikTok]TikTok[/url]
[/list]

As always, should you run into any issues while playing [i]Disney Dreamlight Valley[/i], we first recommend that you check out our known issues [url=https://trello.com/b/WY5gDde3/disney-dreamlight-valley-issue-tracker-board]here[/url]. If you don’t see the issue you’re running into, you can get in touch with our Support team via [url=https://gameloft.helpshift.com/hc/en/66-disney-dreamlight-valley/]our contact form[/url]. Stumped with a certain quest or objective? Check out our friendly [url=https://discord.com/invite/disneydreamlightvalley]Discord Community[/url] for some Disney Dreamlight Valley tips and tricks!

See you in the Valley!

notes.title: Dapper Delights Update Patch Notes
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42317391/9a1fbde767a28978f31a7304427e99ede1d90601.png[/img]

Hey Valley Villagers!

It’s the Monday before an update launch and you know what that means: patch notes! Over the last two weeks, we’ve shared some exciting previews of what you can expect from this update – from the [url=https://disneydreamlightvalley.com/news/ValleyVignette]Valley Vignette[/url] to the [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=rSxT9F4kDVc]Developer Update[/url] – and we’re excited to share even more today.

Similar to the “Thrills & Frills” Update in May, the “Dapper Delights” Update will include some much-anticipated content for base game owners, as well as the thrilling conclusion to [i]Disney Dreamlight Valley: A Rift in Time[/i], available to all expansion pass owners. As always, scroll down for a breakdown of new content, quality of life improvements, bug fixes and more you can expect from this update!

Prepare yourself! [i]Disney Dreamlight Valley’s[/i] “Dapper Delights” Update arrives on August 21, 2024! Check out all the details below:


[h1]NEW CONTENT (AVAILABLE TO ALL PLAYERS*):[/h1]

[list]
[*] A new character! Revel in the magic of cooking as you welcome Tiana from Disney’s [i]The Princess and the Frog[/i] to the Valley, alongside new Friendship Quests and unique new items.
[*] A new restaurant! Tiana’s Palace is open for business, providing villagers a new spot to grab a meal with friends.
[*] A new stall! Visit Tiana’s Meal Stall to purchase delicious meals, rotating daily.
[*] A new Star Path – also named Dapper Delights! – makes a statement with a new Dream Style for Donald Duck and clothing, hairstyles, makeup, and furniture, inspired by the Roaring Twenties.
[*] A new Signature Bundle in the Premium Shop! Ariel's Royal Bundle offers a wide range of customization items inspired by Disney’s [i]The Little Mermaid[/i], including a Dream Style for Ariel, a House Style inspired by Prince Eric’s village, and clothing items and furniture that exudes opulence.
[*] Weekly rotations to look forward to! Keep an eye out for new optional items in the Premium Shop (alongside some returning favorites), as well as new, weekly DreamSnaps challenges and rewards.
[*] New shipment alert! Scrooge McDuck’s Store has received a new batch of goods for sale, including new clothes!
[*] A new type of furniture! Keep an eye out for future furniture that allows you to interact with it to gather random villagers for a photo op.
[*] If you previously purchased the Nefarious Tool Set or Skeletal Tool Set from the Premium Shop, you will receive a complimentary, matching Royal Hourglass skin for these sets. These Royal Hourglass styles will be included as part of these two tool sets, moving forward.
[/list]

[i]* Please note: Disney Dreamlight Valley Arcade Edition does not include seasonal Star Paths or the Premium Shop.[/i]

[h1]NEW CONTENT (EXPANSION PASS OWNERS):[/h1]

[list]
[*] Return to Ancient’s Landing for Act III – “Treasures of Time” – which is the final act of [i]Disney Dreamlight Valley: A Rift in Time[/i]!
[*] Jafar makes his way from Eternity Isle to the Valley, opening the door to new Friendship Quests and new unique items!
[*] Bring a touch of unpredictability to Scramblecoin with the new Jafar figurine, which changes its movement with each turn it spends on the board.
[/list]

[h1]IMPROVEMENTS (AVAILABLE TO ALL PLAYERS):[/h1]

[h2]EDIT MODE, FURNITURE & WARDROBE:[/h2]

[list]
[*] Added a search filter to the Furniture and Wardrobe menus.
[*] Added the ability to mark items as “Favorites” or “Hidden” in the Furniture and Wardrobe menus, adding these items to relevant new categories and surfacing favorite items to the top of these menus.
[*] Added the ability to save custom outfit presets, making it easy to switch between full outfits.
[*] Added a “new item” tag to items in the Wardrobe and Furniture menus.
[*] Added new sorting options to the Wardrobe and Furniture menus.
[*] Added the ability to remove all furniture from a room at once, resetting a room.
[/list]

[h2]PHOTO MODE:[/h2]

[list]
[*] Added 2 new full body Avatar poses to Photo Mode.
[/list]

[h2]ACTIVITIES:[/h2]

[list]
[*] Added a toggle to the Settings menu that replaces fishing and timebending button presses with a “hold button” prompt.
[*] Added a toggle to the cooking menu that turns off the “results” screen and animation while cooking, speeding up the cooking process.
[/list]

[h2]REMY’S SPECIAL DELIVERIES:[/h2]

[list]
[*] Increased the base number of Wrought Iron rewarded for requests to 6, while increasing the max reward to 15.
[*] Reduced the amount of Wrought Iron required to craft certain tables and chairs.
[*] Increased the amount of Wrought Iron rewarded for completing Stitch’s big order.
[*] Reduced the number of pies needed for the pie-eating contest.
[*] If you’ve unlocked Remy’s Special Deliveries, keep an eye out for a message in your mailbox from Remy, detailing the above changes and gift you some Wrought Iron for your troubles. This will be available until mid-September.
[*] Adjusted the “Wrought Iron -> Iron Ingot” crafting recipe to appear only after the completion of the first Remy’s Special Deliveries quest to limit confusion.
[/list]

[h2]PREMIUM SHOP:[/h2]

[list]
[*] Implemented various UI improvements.
[/list]

[h2]OTHER:[/h2]

[list]
[*] Belle’s character model has been reworked to better capture the magic of her character!
[*] Cross-platform play is now supported on PlayStation consoles.
[*] Continued optimizations to reduce crash rates on all platforms.
[*] Reduced loading times on player profiles, with a particularly pronounced effect on Valleys that have a high number of placed objects.
[*] Adjusted the schedules of critters in the Valley to provide more accessible windows for finding some of the rarer animal companions.
[*] Adjusted villager schedules to allow players to visit their favorite characters any time of day. During periods when villagers would have been previously inaccessible, they will now be found taking it easy at home.
[*] Adjusted the default sprint button on gamepad to Left Bumper to allow for more comfortable use of the game camera. [i]We are investigating further improvements to gamepad user experience for a future update, so please stay tuned![/i]
[/list]

[h1]TOP CHANGES AND BUG FIXES:[/h1]

[list]
[*] “Village Project: Timeless Treasures” quest: Fixed an issue in which the Timebending Table would be missing from the player’s inventory.
[*] “What's Left Behind” quest: Fixed an issue in which some players were unable to pick up the Orb of Remembrance.
[*] “Diamond in the Rough” quest: Fixed an issue in which some players were unable to pick up the Jewel of Time.
[*] “My Kingdom for a Scroll” quest: Fixed an issue in which Scrooge McDuck’s chest would not spawn.
[*] “A Deal with Ursula” quest: Fixed an issue in which some players were unable to place the fourth crystal on its pedestal.
[*] “A Restaurant Makeover” quest: Fixed an issue in which some players were unable to enter Chez Remy during this quest.
[*] “The Sundial” quest: Fixed an issue in which the required gears would not register as found.
[*] “The Sundial” quest: Fixed an issue in which players on Apple Arcade platforms were unable to catch the sun core item if they had no gamepad connected.
[*] “An Alarming Development” quest: Fixed an issue in which players on Apple Arcade platforms were unable to catch the alarm clocks if they had no gamepad connected.
[*] “The Tower” quest: Fixed an issue in which removing the final Swirling Sand would not be properly registered.
[*] “Does Not Compute” quest: Fixed an issue in which the required beach area would be inaccessible.
[*] “Flying Metal Nuisance” quest: Fixed an issue in which sandstones could block the player from progressing in this quest.
[*] “Trouble in Paradise” quest: Fixed an issue in which flowerpots could block the way into Daisy Duck’s house.
[*] Fixed instances in which a small portion of game progress could roll back after a crash.
[*] Fixed an issue in which a visual bug would show an incorrect Moonstone value until the player rebooted the game.
[*] Fixed an issue which would occasionally cause Vanellope to appear as invisible.
[*] Fixed an issue in which doors would occasionally disappear when placed in the player’s house.
[*] Fixed an issue in which the player would be unable to glide while the energy bar is yellow.
[*] Fixed an issue in which some players did not receive Gold Edition or expansion pass rewards in their in-game mailbox.
[*] Fixed an issue in which some macOS users would encounter online services errors.
[*] Fixed an issue which caused coffee tables to be difficult to grab in Edit Mode.
[*] Fixed an issue in which multiple different versions of the Oswaldian Trolley Tracks had the same name.
[*] Fixed an issue in which it was unclear what tasks needed to be completed to satisfy daily challenges in The Boutique.
[*] Fixed an issue in which a bookshelf could become stuck if placed in front of the interior door of the Avatar’s house.
[*] Fixed an issue in which some players were unable to pick up books dropped from their inventories.
[*] Fixed an issue in which some memory orbs could become unreachable under the sink in Remy’s house.
[*] Fixed an issue in which the Miracle Fishing Bait buff would last for longer than intended.
[*] Fixed an issue in which placed popcorn buckets would occasionally disappear.
[*] Fixed an issue where some clothing would not resize to character's Avatar.
[*] Fixed an issue in which the "remove the small night thorns" duty would not progress.
[*] Various additional bug fixes relating to audio, visual, localization, gamepad control, and user interface issues, in addition to stability improvements.
[/list]
